author: Sebastian Lotzer
title: Ein Gespenst geht um in Europa¹
content:
“Die Aufstände kommen, sie sind bereits hier. Weitere sind unterwegs, daran besteht kein Zweifel. Sie verdienen eine angemessene Theorie. Eine Theorie des Aufstandes ist zugleich eine Theorie der Krise. Dies gilt sowohl im umgangssprachlichen Sinn wie auch auf lokaler Ebene, in den von zersplittertem Glas und brennenden Barrikaden geprägten Momenten, in denen der Aufstand als Unterbrechung einer verzweifelten Situation gesehen wird: Verelendung am Limit, die Krise einer Gemeinschaft oder Stadt, unterbrochen für einige Stunden oder Tage. Die innere und strukturelle Bedeutung des Aufstandes, um Frantz Fanon zu paraphrasieren, lässt sich allerdings nur als solche erkennen, wenn wir die historische Bewegung kennen, die ihm seine Form und Substanz verleiht. Wir müssen folglich zu weiteren Ebenen vordringen, auf denen die zunehmenden Fälle von Aufständen untrennbar mit der anhaltenden und systemischen Krise des Kapitalismus verbunden sind. Außerdem erhellt der Aufstand als besondere Form des Kampfes den Charakter der Krise, macht diese erneut denkbar und eröffnet eine Perspektive auf ihre Entfaltung.”




“Schließlich ist der historische Materialismus eine Theorie der Transformation, was nicht bedeuten kann, jede historische Wendung oder Entwicklungsstufe zu affirmieren. Aber ein Marxismus, der die Tendenz der Realität nur als Abweichung erkennen kann, ist überhaupt kein Marxismus. Die Bedeutung des Aufstandes hat sich dramatisch gewandelt, er wird nicht zu verstehen sein, ohne die Determinationen und Kräfte zu benennen die ihm seine neue Rolle verleihen und von denen er unaufhaltsam vorwärts, in die Zukunft, getrieben wird, während er noch auf das 17. und 18. Jahrhundert zurückblickt. Was grundsätzlich notwendig ist, ist deshalb eine dezidiert materialistische Theorie des Aufstandes. Aufstand für Kommunisten sozusagen.”




Joshua Clover²




Prolog




Nachdem die französische Jugendrevolte sich auch nach Italien ausgebreitet hat und es in verschiedenen Städten zu Krawallen gekommen ist, schickte die italienische Regierung am letzten Wochenende Fallschirmjägereinheiten nach Mailand, wo den Bullen die Lage völlig entglitten war, über Stunden Straßenkämpfe und umfangreiche Plünderungen am vorletzten Wochenende. Während die Soldaten mit Sturmgewehren bewaffnet durch die abgeriegelte Innenstadt von Mailand patrouillieren, kommt es trotz erhöhten Einsatz von Polizeieinheiten in anderen italienischen Städten wieder zu Krawallen. Am letzten Freitag beteiligen sich landesweit mehrere hunderttausend Menschen an Demonstrationen gegen den Krieg und die Folgen der sozialen Krise, die Basisgewerkschaften haben zu Streiks aufgerufen, unter anderem wird der Hafen von Genua blockiert, erneute Zusammenstöße in mehreren Städten, in Rom über Stunden, dort auch Barrikadenbau und stundenlange Kämpfe mit den Bullen.




In Deutschland kursieren seit Tagen Aufrufe, sich am 31. Oktober “den französischen Protesten anzuschließen”, und während im Netz witzige Videos kursieren, indem man vor den Auslagen eines Rolex Stores posiert, lässt der typisch deutsche Organisationsfetisch zunächst wenig Hoffnung aufkommen. Ausschüsse und Posten werden gegründet und verabschieden sich sofort wieder, jeder meint sich von irgendetwas distanzieren zu müssen, vor allem “von der Gewalt”, die üblichen linken Verdächtigen versuchen auf der (vorerst viralen) Welle mitzureiten und der mediale Hype erschließt sich nicht einmal auf den zweiten Blick. Immerhin kontert die mit dem Sicherheitsapparat bestens vernetzte WELT die allgemeine Hysterie mit Stimmen aus den Sicherheitsbehörden, “es gäbe keinerlei Hinweise auf grössere Ausschreitungen”, trotzdem legen die Luxusgeschäfte am Kurfürstendamm in Berlin eine Nachtschicht ein und die Bilder von den mit Sperrholzplatten verrammelten Geschäften gehen um die Welt. In Paris bestätigen die Gerichte letztinstanzlich die zwangsweise Verlegung der für den 31. Oktober geplanten Gewerkschaftsdemo in die Außenbezirke, was ungefähr so wäre, als wenn man der alljährlichen 1. Mai Demo in Berlin nur eine Route in Spandau gestatten würde.




Akt Eins




Am Nachmittag des 31.Oktober versammeln sich gerade einmal um die 4.000 Menschen am Brandenburger Tor zur Kundgebung von “GenZregelt”. 80 % sind Studenten aus der Mittelschicht und die üblichen linken Dauerprotestierer. Fast durchgängig weiß, Jugendliche sieht man Wenige und auch die sind vom Outfit eher der typischen Berliner Protestszene zuzuordnen. Ein paar in die Jahre gekommene Granden der Autonomen machen auch ihre Aufwartung und auch ‘der Blues’ schaut vorbei. Jede öde 1. Mai Demo des DGB versprüht mehr Charme. Vorhang zu und ab.




Akt Zwei




In 30 Städten beteiligen sich 50.00 – 100.00 Menschen an den Demonstrationen von ‘GenZregelt’. In Hamburg und Stuttgart kommt es schon während der Demos mit jeweils mehreren tausend Menschen zu Auseinandersetzungen mit den Bullen, es werden Wasserwerfer eingesetzt. In Karlsruhe wird eine Versammlung unter Einsatz von Reiterstaffeln aufgelöst. Auch in Köln und Leipzig kommt es zu Auseinandersetzungen während der Demos. Berlin pfeift sich nach der Ödnis am Brandenburger Tor erst einmal ein paar Red Bull ein, am frühen Abend trifft man sich dann am Rosenthaler Platz in Mitte. Nach für Berliner Verhältnisse ungewöhnlich kurzer Wartezeit geht es im schnellen Laufschritt in Richtung Prenzlauer Berg. Kein Lautsprecherwagen, keine festen Blöcke, dafür überall Jugendliche, die Bock haben, auch das migrantische Surplus-Proletariat ist unübersehbar vertreten. Im Affentempo geht es im Zickzack durch die teilweise dunklen Seitenstrasse, niemand blickt durch, auch nicht die Bullen, die verzweifelt mit hohem Kräfteansatz versuchen einen Frontblock zu begleiten, den es eigentlich aber nicht wirklich gibt. Immer wieder Pyrotechnik und “ganz Berlin hasst die Polizei”, zahllose Gelegenheiten auf der Route werden liegen gelassen, heute scheint nicht der Tag dafür. Am Ende haben die Berliner Bullen dann doch wieder einen Plan und stoppen die Demo an einer für sie taktisch gut gelegenen Stelle auf. Eine helle Hauptstraße mit wenig Seitenstrassen und wenig Publikumsverkehr, eine Straßenbahn verirrt sich im Chaos und wird voll gesprüht, Pyrotechnik und Flaschen fliegen auf die Bullen, die immer wieder in die Menge prügeln. Viele Verletzte und Festnahmen, aber es ist Halloween und irgendwie will sich die Jugend nicht den Spaß nehmen lassen und so geht das Chaos in die nächste Runde. Erst nach einer Stunde macht sich so etwas wie Ernüchterung breit und die Meisten sickern aus dem Kessel in die Berliner Nacht.




Akt Drei




In Frankreich beteiligen sich am Acte lll über eine halbe Millionen Menschen an den landesweiten Demonstrationen, die teilweise trotz behördlicher Verbote stattfanden. Trotz der massiven Repression – alleine am 31.10. an die 800 Festnahmen, erneut großflächiger Tränengas – und Wasserwerfereinsatz in mehreren Städten – waren an diesem Wochenende fast so viele Menschen auf den Straßen wie am letzten Wochenende. Erneut kam es in etlichen Städten zu Barrikadenbau und Angriffe auf die Bullen, besonders in Rennes, Lyon, Toulouse, Marseille. In Paris kam es am Endpunkt der Demo zu heftigen Prügeleien mit den Bullen, eine Einheit der Gendarmerie wurde vor laufenden Medienkameras mit Molotows beworfen. Später am Abend dann auch Barrikadenbau und Angriffe auf die Bullen von mobilen Gruppen in der Innenstadt von Paris, während die Bullen eine große friedliche Halloween Party von tausenden Jugendlichen am Fuße des Eiffelturms komplett mit Tränengas auseinandernehmen. In den späten Abendstunden dezentraler Barrikadenbau und Stress mit den Sicherheitskräften vor allem in Lyon und Marseille. In Lyon haben die Faschos auch dieses Wochenende versucht, in einer größeren Gruppe versprengte Demonstranten anzugreifen, wurden aber dann selbst durch die Straßen gejagt. Der Innenminister feiert sich selbst nun für seine Strategie, das Demonstrationsrecht für praktisch alle größeren französischen Innenstädte außer Kraft zu setzen. „Der Ausnahmezustand ist zur Struktur des Regierens geworden“ – Giorgio Agamben. Le Pen fordert mehr Härte, LFI mehr Partizipation und Gen Z: „Uns bleiben noch ein paar Gramm Leben, und wir werden alles geben“³




Akt Vier




Nicht nur Kreuzberger Nächte sind lang, deshalb die weiteren Geschehnisse (unvollständig [4]) des Abends in Berlin: Im Märkischen Viertel versammelt sich eine größere Gruppe Jugendlicher an einem Einkaufszentrum und bewirft Einsatzkräfte mit Pyrotechnik, später fliegt ein Molotow auf eine Einsatzfahrzeug, die Bullen nehmen wenig später zwei 14Jährige (!) fest, die angeblich Benzin in Plastikflaschen mit sich führen. Gegen 23:00 Uhr wird in der Huttenstraße eine stabile Barrikade aus E Scootern, Baustellenmaterial und brennenden Mülltonnen errichtet, in selbiger Straße wurden in den vergangenen Jahren zu Silvester immer wieder Barrikaden errichtet. In der westlichen City werden an verschiedenen Stellen Mülltonnen auf der Straße entzündet, am Tauentzien, der westlichen Verlängerung des Kurfürstendamm versucht eine Gruppe mit Verkehrsschildern ein Geschäft aufzubrechen. In Kreuzberg werden nach Mitternacht ebenfalls an mehreren Stellen Mülltonnen in Brand gesetzt, an der High-Deck-Siedlung, einem der Schauplätze der schweren Krawalle zu Silvester 22/23 wird ein Polizeifahrzeug mit einem großen Spannplatte beworfen. In der Nähe des Alexanderplatzes wird ein Bekleidungsgeschäft von einer Gruppe erfolgreich aufgebrochen und diverse Kleidungsstücke umverteilt. Dies alles trotz einer massiven Bullenpräsenz im gesamten Stadtgebiet, insbesondere mit Einheiten der Einsatzhundertschaften in den Großraumsiedlungen, die schon zu Silvester 22/23 Schauplätze von Ausschreitungen waren.




Unterdessen ist die Demo in Hamburg zu Ende gegangen, in St. Georg haben sich aber Hunderte festgesetzt, immer wieder werden Barrikaden gebaut, die Einsatzkräfte werden mit Flaschen und Steinen beworfen, es dauert mehrere Stunden, bis die Bullen die Lage beruhigen können. Auch in Duisburg, Halle und Duisburg gibt es Stress am Halloween Abend, in Köln fliegen Mietfahrräder auf die Bullen, später werden Molotows sichergestellt. Auch die Schweiz gesellt sich am Abend zum Halloween-Spektakel. In Bern und Zürich knallt es, in Zürich verlieren die Bullen über Stunden den Zugriff auf die Situation trotz Wasserwerfer und Gummischrot. Brennende Barrikaden und Plünderungen im Kreis vier, die NZZ schreibt: “Krawalle mit Ansage – aber kaum Festnahmen in Zürich. Die Halloween-Taktik der Linksextremen ist aufgegangen”.




Doch kommen wir nach Deutschland zurück. In Frankfurt erlebt die Staatsmacht ihren Meltdown. Um die 2.000 Menschen übernehmen eine längere Zeit die teilweise Kontrolle über die weltbekannte Einkaufsmeile Auf der Zeil. Brennende Barrikaden, die Bullen werden mit allem eingedeckt, darunter auch Molotows, Geschäfte geplündert, ein Waffengeschäft wird aufgebrochen. Erst nach Mitternacht gelingt es der Staatsmacht, das Gewaltmonopol wiederherzustellen. Am Ende wird das SEK in voller Ausrüstung losgeschickt, mit den Schnellfeuergewehren im Anschlag soll die Ohnmacht des Staates kaschiert werden. G20 Hamburg lässt grüßen.




Epilog




Der Schlag des Schmetterlings. Was als eine Blockade an einer Oberschule in der Banlieue von Paris begann, ist der Aufstand einer Jugend geworden. Eine Jugend, die in ihren Sommerferien die Wälder des Südens des Kontinents in Flammen aufgehen sieht, begreift endgültig und bewusst, dass das ihre Zukunft ist. Unwiderruflich. Real wie metamorphisch. Kein ‘sozialer Aufstieg”, kein ‘Ruhestand’ am Ende eines erschöpfenden Arbeitslebens, nur eine Welt aus Krieg, Zerstörung, Trümmern, Rauch, brutalen Verteidigungskämpfen. Gaza ist nicht das Sinnbild dieser Generation geworden weil es einen allgegenwärtigen Antisemistismus gibt (auch wenn es diesen streckenweise gibt und dieser thematisiert und bekämpft werden muss), sondern weil das ihre Frage an die Zukunft ist: Wie Menschlichkeit möglich ist in einer Welt aus Trümmern…? Und natürlich ist die Avantgarde, um diese aus guten Gründen aus der Mode geratene Begrifflichkeit wieder in den Diskurs einzuführen, jener Teil, der die Aufstände unserer Epoche anführt, der am entschiedendsten kämpft, der der meisten Opfer für diesen Kampf bringt, das jugendliche Surplus Proletariat. Migrantisch gelesen, wie man heutzutage sagt. Sie warten nicht mehr, bis eine KI ihre Buillshit Jobs obsolet macht, sie haben nicht die Option der kleinbürgerlichen Großstadtblasen, das soziale Downgrade infolge der KI Revolution durch die Flucht in die Besitzstandtümer der eigenen Eltern abzumildern. Sie werden arm geboren und sie werden arm sterben. Wie ihre Eltern. Von denen so viele sich aufgeopfert haben, damit es ihren Kindern einmal nicht so geht. Eigentlich reichen die Kämpfe dieses Teils der Bevölkerung schon viel länger zurück. Ziad Benna und Bouna Traoré 2005, Nahel 2023. Und, und, und… Jedes Mal explodierte die Wut und Perspektivlosigkeit, jedes Mal wartete die Gesellschaft, bis sich der Rauch verzogen hatte und machte dann einfach weiter. Doch nun wird es kein Weiter mehr geben. Zu tief ist der Riss, durch den der soziale Antagonismus wieder auf die Tagesordnung gesetzt wird. Tagesordnungspunkt EINS: Klassenkampf. Kein identitäres Gefasel, kein Bullshit Bingo um ideologische Referenzen. Nur das nackte: Wem gehört was? Wer trägt dafür die Verantwortung, dass unsere Welt dabei ist, vor die Hunde zu gehen. Der Aufstand nach dem Mord an Nahel hörte noch auf den Namen Rache. Jetzt geht es um mehr. Hysterical Strength. Ein Mensch ist in der Lage, alleine ein ganzes Auto hochstemmen, unter dem sein eingeklemmtes Kind liegt. Corona, bzw. die ergriffenen Maßnahmen, waren die Generalstabsübung unserer Gegner für ein allgemeines und dauerhaftes Ausnahmezustand- Regime, mit dem sie versuchen, den Laden am Laufen zu halten, während sie uns ihre Kriege um die Ohren hauen, weil sie ihre Verwertungskrise einfach nicht gelöst bekommen. Die Revolte, die sich in diesem Herbst durch Europa frisst, ist unsere Generalstabsübung für den ‘kommenden Aufstand’.




Wie Clover richtig sagte, und man müsste hinzufügen, wie Quadrelli viel detaillierter und konkreter hinzufügte, geht es darum eine materialistische Theorie des Aufstandes zu formulieren und zu verbreiten. Dies ist unsere Aufgabe als “aufständische Denker”. Bei den konkreten sozialen Explosionen sind wir eh nur Randfiguren, ohne wirkliche praktische Bedeutung, häufig sogar eher unerwünscht, weil wir nicht “dazu gehören”, aus der “falschen Gegend kommen” oder einfach bescheuert aussehen. Das ist in Ordnung so. Aber wie ich schon in meinen ‘Fragmenten zum 17. Oktober’ [5] schrieb, waren die Aufstände und Revolten der letzten beiden Dekaden, die im Bruch mit der historischen Linken sich generierten, nicht in der Lage, aus sich heraus eine “revolutionäre Theorie” zu entwickeln, die konkrete Vorstellungen entwickelte wie dieses System endlich in den Abgrund der Geschichte gestürzt werden kann, ehe es uns alle mitreisst. Es geht nicht darum, irgendetwas anzuführen oder irgendwen zu belehren, es geht darum brauchbare grundsätzliche Vorschläge zu unterbreiten, auf deren Grundlage der Aufstand generalisiert und seine soziale Basis verbreitert werden kann, um ihn eine eine revolutionäre Erhebung zu überführen. Was wir derzeit erleben, ist ein Übereinanderlappen der sozialen Segmente und Milieus. Surplus, Überreste der ‘Palästina-Bewegung’, Überreste der militanten linken und anarchistischen Blasen und Grüppchen, die neuen K-Gruppen, … Ein Sammelsurium, das ist erstmal okay, aber mehr nicht. Ohne theoretische Unterfütterung wird dies alles schnell wieder auseinanderbrechen. Und ja, die Theorie ist in Verruf geraten, und man muss hinzufügen, zu Recht. Aber es geht ihr wie dem Klassenkampf, am Ende ist sie unverzichtbar und ohne sie nichts Grundsätzliches zu gewinnen. Die Zeit drängt. Es gibt unumkehrbare biologische Prozesse, bzw. wird es sehr, sehr lange dauern, zumindest einen Teil davon zu reparieren, was die kapitalistische Zivilisation zerstört hat. Doch manchmal ist hoher Druck gar nicht so verkehrt. Manchmal braucht es dieses Unentrückbare, um die gewaltigen Kräfte zu mobilisieren, mit denen man scheinbar aussichtslose geschichtliche Prozesse zu seinen Gunsten kippen kann. Darum geht es. Um nicht weniger. Danke liebe Jugend, dass ihr uns daran erinnert, was kämpfen wirklich heißt.




Sebastian Lotzer, Berlin Kreuzberg – 1. November 2026

author: winter oak
title: Raising ourselves from the lowness of modernity
content:
by Paul Cudenec, who reads the article 

here




Ernst Friedrich Schumacher (1911-1977)

 is best remembered for his 1973 book 

Small is Beautiful: A Study of Economics As If People Mattered

 and its message that “infinite growth in a finite environment is an obvious impossibility”. [1]




As the title of the book conveys, he saw it as important to restore a human scale to human self-organisation: “Centralisation is mainly an idea of order; decentralisation, one of freedom”. [2]




Schumacher’s attack on centralisation and economic growth went hand in hand with a broader assault on industrial society itself.




He noted in 

Small is Beautiful

 that “modern man has built a system of production that ravishes nature and a type of society that mutilates man”. [3]




As I explain in my 

profile

 of Schumacher on the organic radicals site, [4] he also challenged the 

ways of thinking

 which have allowed the industrial 

mega-racket

 [5] to gain its stranglehold on our lives.










One of these is the obsession with the idea of paid “work” – of any kind, no matter how pointless or harmful – as being an essential bulwark of everyone’s existence.




He explained: “That soul-destroying, meaningless, mechanical, monotonous, moronic work is an insult to human nature which must necessarily and inevitably produce either escapism or aggression, and that no amount of ‘bread and circuses’ can compensate for the damage done – these are facts which are neither denied nor acknowledged but are met with an unbreakable conspiracy of silence – because to deny them would be too obviously absurd and to acknowledge them would condemn the central preoccupation of modern society as a crime against humanity”. [6]




Our separation from nature is, of course, another key problem: “Modern man does not experience himself as a part of nature but as an outside force destined to dominate and destroy it”. [7]




As well as being inspired by the decentralist, degrowth economic ideas of organic radical inspirations 

Mohandas Gandhi

 [8] and 

Leopold Kohr

, [9] Schumacher was also influenced by the metaphysical critique of modernity voiced by the perennialist wing of the revived tradition.




In 

Small is Beautiful

 he quoted both 

Aldous Huxley

 [10] and 

Ananda Coomaraswamy

 [11] and he explained in 

A Guide for the Perplexed

 that he had taken the term “the Reign of Quantity” from 

René Guénon

 (

pictured

), [12] “one of the few significant metaphysicians of our time”. [13]










It was this aspect of Schumacher’s thinking which lay behind his judgement in the latter book, first published in 1977, that “while wealth may still be accumulating, the quality of man declines”. [14]




It also informed his criticism of the one-dimensionality of modern thought, in contrast to the “three-dimensional structure” of traditional wisdom. [15]




Contemporary society rejects ideas of “higher” or “lower” degrees of quality in favour of judgements based purely on quantity, he pointed out.




And yet the idea of something being “higher” is almost universally used in traditional ways of thinking across the world, he said: “‘Higher’ always means and implies ‘more inner’, ‘more interior’, ‘deeper’, ‘more intimate’; while ‘lower’ means and implies ‘more outer’, ‘more external’, ‘shallower’, ‘less intimate’. This synonymity can be found in many languages, perhaps in all of them”. [16]




It is also at the root of our ethical judgements, which regard good as being a “higher” quality than evil, argued Schumacher.




He observed: “The modern world tends to be sceptical about everything that demands man’s higher faculties. But it is not at all sceptical about scepticism, which demands hardly anything”. [17]










A Guide for the Perplexed

 is refreshingly clear about the obvious dead-end represented by the industrial monstrosity we are told is “civilization”.




Schumacher writes: “The faith in modern man’s omnipotence is wearing thin. Even if all the ‘new’ problems were solved by technological fixes, the state of futility, disorder and corruption would remain. It existed before the present crises became acute, and it will not go away by itself. More and more people are beginning to realise that ‘the modern experiment’ has failed”. [18]




Troy Southgate, whose fascinating political journey I recently 

described

, [19] takes a close look at Schumacher’s philosophy through the lens of this particular work in his 2025 book 

The World According to Fritz: E.F. Schumacher and The Perennial Philosophy

.




Obviously, there is much thematic overlap with what I wrote about, but Southgate goes into more detail in his 120 pages than I could in my profile and he does pick out some choice quotes that I wish I had used, such as Schumacher’s evocation of “the progressive constriction and narrowing of the modern mind”. [20]




He points out: “For Schumacher things have continued to decline ever since the Cartesian revolution set out to reshape man’s view of the universe.




Science Fiction

 by 

Jordan Henderson







“Logic has separated man from the great Chain of Being and, rather to seek to elevate himself to the heavens, he has fallen into a hell of his own making”. [21]




“The rationalist methodology favoured by [René] Descartes does not extend beyond the application of Reason, completely ruling out the potential of the human imagination.




“We must, he announced, even discount the information that we receive from our senses and this narrow approach to science and philosophy even suggests that whenever we encounter an intellectual barrier our investigations should cease”. [22]




Channelling Schumacher’s viewpoint, Southgate describes how Descartes (1596-1650) “became so arrogant in his efforts to overcome the great minds of the past that he portrayed both ancient and medieval philosophy as examples of congenital error”. [23]




Southgate notes that the thinker  was carrying forward the work begun by Francis Bacon (1561-1626) in launching “a scientific revolution against the established wisdom of antiquity”. [24]










As I set out in August 2025 in ‘

The Invisible College and the plan for our enslavement

‘, [25] I think both of these men were part of a deliberate effort to enact a Great Reset of those times, to undermine the foundations of European thought and culture and so pave the way for our exploitation by judeo-supremacist industrial imperialism.




Southgate describes how Schumacher regarded these changes as a “great impoverishment” in which the age-old roadmap to life had been discarded by the purveyors of a dislocated and confused world. [26]




“It is hardly surprising that we find ourselves in the middle of a tangled forest with a broken compass and no way of finding our way through the wilderness”.




He says that for Schumacher the knowledge of the past is like a network of forgotten footpaths which no longer appears on a map which has changed beyond recognition. [27]




That is very much the insight behind the organic radical project, by the way. While some of the individual thinkers featured there remain well known, what has been hidden from general view are the connections between them; the overview that making such connections can provide; the understanding that together these elements constitute 

another way of thinking

, a 

true and traditional wisdom

 which has been deliberately concealed by the modern tyranny.










Southgate writes that “the reductionist plan of the Cartesian cartographer has dispensed with the qualitative aspects of ‘higher’ and ‘lower’ features and replaced them with purely quantitative effects that offer little guidance on the voyage from A to B”. [28]




Schumacher himself declared: “The old science – ‘Wisdom’ or ‘science for understanding’ – was primarily directed ‘towards the sovereign good’, i.e. the True, the Good and the Beautiful, the knowledge of which would bring both happiness and salvation.




“The new science was directed mainly towards material power, a tendency that has meanwhile developed to such lengths that the enhancement of political and economic power is now generally taken as the first purpose of, and main justification for, expenditure on scientific work.




“The old science looked upon nature as God’s handiwork and man’s mother; the new science tends to look upon it as an adversary to be conquered or a quarry to be exploited”. [29]




From his 2020s perspective, Southgate adds: “What Schumacher calls ‘knowledge for manipulation’ has become an enormous threat and those readers who experienced the so-called pandemic of 2020 onwards will have seen how expressions such as ‘trust the science’ were designed to reinforce a global campaign of systematic disinformation”. [30]










He further cites Schumacher’s 1977 warning regarding this malevolent modern science: “If it continues to be a juggernaut outside humanistic control there will be a reaction and revulsion against it which would not exclude the possibility of violence”. [31]




And Southgate adds: “This has certainly been the case in relation to the authoritarian restrictions that were imposed during the Covid-19 debacle, not to mention similar opposition towards the scientific ‘justification’ for transgender ideology”. [32]




As well as being used to exploit and control us, this science also reduces our individual experience of life and our understanding of its meaning.




Schumacher writes: “We are given a large number of definitions of man which make him out to be nothing but an exceptionally intelligent animal with an unduly large brain, or a tool-making animal, or a political animal, or an unfinished animal, or simply a naked ape.




“No doubt, people who use these terms cheerfully include themselves in their definitions and will have some reason for doing so. Nothing is more conducive to the brutalisation of the modern world than the launching, in the name of science, of wrongful and degraded definitions of man, such as ‘the naked ape’.




“What could one expect of such a creature, of other ‘naked apes’ or, indeed, of oneself? When people speak of animals as ‘animal machines’ they soon start treating them accordingly, and when they think of people as naked apes, all doors are opened to the free entry of bestiality”. [33]










Contemporary industrial thinking drags us down into the 

lower

 level of existence which is its domain, at the same time as denying that any such thing exists.




Schumacher writes: “A person, for instance, entirely fixated in the philosophy of materialistic scientism, denying the reality of the ‘invisibles’ and confining his attention solely to what can be counted, measured and weighed, lives in a very poor world, so poor that he will experience it as a meaningless wasteland unfit for human habitation”. [34]




Modernity’s flat and fragmented analysis means people can only ever see the trees, rather than the wood, said Schumacher: “To say that life is nothing but a property of certain peculiar combinations of atoms is like saying that Shakespeare’s 

Hamlet

 is nothing but a property of a peculiar combination of letters”. [35]




Another way of putting this (

as somebody once wrote – I am not sure who now)

 is to say that it is like dismantling a TV set and scientifically concluding that there is no evidence that the programme you were watching had a plot.




Schumacher (

pictured

) condemned “a view that counts as ‘real’ only inanimate matter and treats as ‘unreal’, ‘subjective’ and therefore scientifically non-existent the invisible dimensions of life, conscioussness and self-awareness”. [36]










Half a century ago, Schumacher would not have been thinking about AI, but that certainly comes to mind when he writes that “the lower level tends to produce a kind of mimicry or counterfeit of the higher, just as an animated puppet can at times be mistaken for a living person, or a two-dimensional picture can look like three-dimensional reality”. [37]




Our task is therefore to extract ourselves from the dungeon of the lower modern industrial world and rediscover the heights which human beings are capable of achieving.




Schumacher said we need to make full use of what he called our intellectual senses, adding: “Without them, we should be unable to recognise form, pattern, regularity, harmony, rhythm and meaning, not to mention life, consciousness and self-awareness”. [38]




We also have to start to think with our hearts rather than our heads. Southgate explains that for Schumacher we can receive “flashes of understanding” that “open ‘the eye of the heart’ and allow truth to enter the soul”. [39]




“The purpose is to remove the mind from the head, where it remains constantly occupied, and redirect it to the place where body and soul converge”. [40]










“Our path, in Schumacher’s eyes, is threefold. Firstly, we must study society in light of tradition with a view to procuring a ‘temporary’ happiness’ from the external confirmation that can be gleaned.




“Secondly, this information must be thoroughly filtered so that we retain the good and discard everything that is bad. This process has been described by the Swiss psychiatrist 

Carl Gustav Jung

 (1875-1961) [41] as ‘individuation’.




“Thirdly, Schumacher says, after completing the first two steps the individual must ‘die’ to himself in the sense that personal likes and dislikes – or what he describes as ‘egocentric preoccupations’ – are considered secondary.




“Instead of being directed from outside, by external influences, one becomes 

self

-directed; this, the ultimate form of freedom is no different to being ‘God-directed'”. [42]

author: Helena Corezomaé
title: O som das conchas ameaçadas
content:
Fui convidada para um casamento no território Rikbaktsa, na região de Brasnorte, Mato Grosso. A noiva não usaria véu, grinalda ou vestido branco, e o noivo não vestiria terno. O enlace, no entanto, seria cercado de ritos, vestes de fibra e comidas tradicionais, como a xixá e o mingau.




A cerimônia gira em torno de uma peça muito importante: o colar tutãra. A tradição dita que a madrinha use o adorno, guiando os noivos até a casa onde a celebração será realizada. O trajeto é feito à noite ou de madrugada, enquanto o som das conchas anuncia o matrimônio para o restante da aldeia.
















O colar tutãra, sagrado para os indígenas Rikbaktsa, pode ser visto nas costas das mulheres




Na prática, porém, não cheguei a presenciar a união. Realizar o casamento tradicional tornou-se um desafio para a comunidade, que hoje esbarra na dificuldade de encontrar as conchas que formam a joia. Retirada exclusivamente das águas do rio Arinos, a matéria-prima do tutãra é esculpida no formato do peixe cará, que, segundo o professor Juarez Paimy, é o peixe-mãe na mitologia Rikbaktsa e o grande símbolo da origem do seu povo.




Conheci os detalhes sobre o casamento pelos relatos das comunicadoras Carol Rikbaktatsa e Lilian Rikbaktatsa, na Aldeia Cajueiro, durante o encerramento da Festa da Chuva. As duas tiveram um papel muito importante, registrando cada momento da festividade, que se estende por seis meses, até a sua finalização. Carol fez o acompanhamento contínuo captando fotos, vídeos e atuando na produção, enquanto Lilian cuidou da mobilização, também registrando o evento em imagens.




O colar existe graças ao rio Arinos (chamado de tutãra Itsik), único local onde o molusco que produz a concha é encontrado em jornadas de coleta que, segundo Lilian, chegam a exigir mais de dois dias de viagem. A integridade desse ecossistema, contudo, enfrenta a ameaça de grandes projetos de infraestrutura.
















Conchas para montar o colar tutãra vem de um tipo de molusco encontrado no rio Arinos




Um deles foi a previsão de instalação da Usina Hidrelétrica Castanheira no rio Arinos e na bacia do rio Juruena — o Juruena corre para o norte após receber o Arinos, se juntando ao Teles Pires para formar o Tapajós. A gravidade das ameaças do projeto foi detalhada no estudo “Saber, Fazer, Existir: O Povo Rikbaktsa, o Tutãra e o Rio Tutãra Itsik”, elaborado pela antropóloga Adriana Athila para a Operação Amazônia Nativa (OPAN). A pesquisa foi encomendada em meio às discussões sobre os impactos da Hidrelétrica. Conforme aponta boletim da OPAN, o empreendimento em questão, agora arquivado, figurava entre 185 projetos com potencial de instalação na bacia do rio Juruena.




Estudo apontou 185 projetos que poderiam ser instalados no rio Juruena, onde vivem os Rikbaktsa




A antropóloga alerta que o Estudo e Relatório de Impacto Ambiental (EIA/RIMA) apresenta lacunas graves, omitindo avaliações sobre a dinâmica dos peixes, da água e do meio biótico. Esse descaso ameaça diretamente a reprodução do molusco Paxyodon syrmatophorus, que produz das conchas usadas no colar tutãra, prevendo-se o seu desaparecimento definitivo na área de coleta imemorial Rikbaktsa.




O estudo de Adriana Athila demonstra que o tutãra, uma das obras de arte plumária e eclética mais elaboradas das Américas, depende de uma complexa interconexão estruturada de comunidades e povos tradicionais. Diante disso, a antropóloga afirma que “nada disso é passível nem de restituição, nem de mitigação”, pois os recursos destruídos pela UHE Castanheira seriam consumidos de forma irreversível.





































São as mulheres que portam o colar sagrado, além de serem quem puxa as danças, cantos e lideram os trabalhos




Um colar que simboliza a força das mulheres e da história indígena




A última grande festa havia sido realizada há seis anos, na aldeia Laranjal, no território Erikpatsa, embora tenha ocorrido uma outra celebração mais recente, em 2024, na aldeia Pé de Mutum, na Terra Indígena Japuíra. O grande diferencial de agora é a memória: não se tem registro visual dessas edições passadas, mas a deste ano estará documentada graças ao trabalho das comunicadoras em cada etapa do evento.




Esse esforço de registrar cada momento ganha ainda mais sentido diante da importância da festa para o povo. Sobre a importância de vivenciar e documentar essa extensa celebração, Carol destaca:







“A festa cultural é importante para nós porque valoriza a nossa cultura, mantém vivo o que a gente já vinha fazendo ao longo do tempo e fortalece a nossa comunidade aqui dentro. É um momento onde todos nós nos reunimos para celebrar a fartura do que o pessoal planta nas roças, onde os clãs se juntam para preparar a própria alimentação para os dias de festa. É um encontro que acontece todo fim de semana durante seis meses, até a finalização. Para nós, enquanto juventude, é ali dentro que a gente conhece um pouco mais das nossas histórias, que os anciões compartilham com a gente, mostram como as coisas eram feitas antigamente e nos ensinam sobre as nossas crenças e espíritos”



















Festas mantém tradições vivas e fortalecem identidade do povo indígena




Acompanhei os três últimos dias dessa cerimônia que, como ressaltou Carol, dura meses e segue um ritmo rigoroso. O primeiro dia dessa etapa de encerramento é dedicado ao preparo das flautas e às rodas de cantoria; no segundo, preparam-se as comidas rituais, como o mingau de macaco, beju e xixá de banana; no terceiro, ocorre a distribuição do mingau.




E foi justamente nessa reta final, após dois dias de espera e certa apreensão, que o tutãra apareceu: duas mulheres surgiram vestindo o adorno, e a cascata de conchas que descia rumo ao chão era muito maior do que eu imaginava.




Vivenciando de perto essa cena, pude entender a verdadeira extensão do colar. A peça ultrapassa a união de casais e enfeita o corpo das mulheres também nas festas da chuva e da seca. Mais do que isso, o momento evidenciou a força daquelas mulheres, que não apenas portavam o colar sagrado, mas também puxavam as danças, os cantos e lideravam os trabalhos.




Viver tudo aquilo, no entanto, exigiu de mim presença e muito respeito. A sociedade Rikbaktsa divide-se em dois grandes clãs: Makwarak (arara-amarela) e Rarubitsi (arara-cabeçuda). Logo na chegada, Lurdes Wahomy Rikbaktatsa, liderança da comunidade, me acolheu e usou o jenipapo para me inserir na comunidade. Ela testou em minha pele a pintura dos dois grupos, explicando que a que ficasse melhor definiria o clã no qual eu ficaria. A escolhida acabou sendo a da arara-cabeçuda, colocando-me, assim, no mesmo grupo de Lurdes.
















A sociedade Rikbaktsa divide-se em dois grandes clãs: Makwarak (arara-amarela) e Rarubitsi (arara-cabeçuda)




Seguindo o fluxo dessa convivência, sentei na roda com as mulheres do meu novo clã. Juntas, descascamos e ralamos castanhas por um bom tempo para o preparo do mingau de macaco. Depois de algumas horas nessa atividade, uma das mulheres me liberou: “Vai, agora tire as suas fotos”. O consentimento veio como a confirmação de um laço de confiança construído na partilha da tarefa.




“O tutãra é sagrado pra nós. Mais que um colar de casamento, a peça é a representação da cultura, história e conexão do povo Rikbaktsa com o meio ambiente”, me explicou Lucinete Mukda Rikbaktsa, presidente da Associação Indígena de Mulheres Rikbaktsa (Aimurik).




Diferente de outros adornos plumários da comunidade, o tutãra tem a particularidade de ser feito e usado exclusivamente pelas mulheres. Sua estrutura combina discos de coco-de-tucum com pingentes do molusco bivalve Paxyodon syrmatophorus. As conchas são fervidas com cinzas para limpeza, esculpidas no formato do peixe cará e finalizadas com um “cobre-costas” adornado com pelos de caititu e penas de arara e mutum.

author: Wanessa Celina
title: PL reúne-se esta semana para debater candidatura de Rogério Marinho a presidente do Senado
content:
Com o fim do mandato de Davi Alcolumbre (União-AP) na presidência do Senado, o Partido Liberal (PL) se articula para lançar o senador Rogério Marinho (PL-RN) como candidato à vaga. Nesta terça-feira, 3 de novembro, senadores eleitos e com mandato do partido se reúnem para avaliar o nome de Marinho, que conta com o apoio do senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ).




Como concorrentes à presidência, estão a senadora Tereza Cristina (PP-MS), ex-ministra do Ministério da Agricultura, Pecuária e Abastecimento no Jair Bolsonaro, e o senador Davi Alcolumbre (União-AP), que busca a reeleição. 




A defesa de Jair Bolsonaro, em prisão domiciliar cumprindo pena por tentativa de golpe de Estado, pediu ao ministro Alexandre de Moraes liberação para uma visita de Rogério Marinho à casa do ex-presidente nos dias 3 e 5 de novembro. O pedido ocorreu após Valdemar Costa Neto, presidente do PL, visitar Bolsonaro após a fuga do candidato do partido à Presidência da República e derrotado, senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), para os Estados Unidos.




Na Câmara dos Deputados, a Comissão de Constituição e Justiça e de Cidadania (CCJC) debate o Projeto de Lei que instaura um período de transição administrativa entre o fim das eleições e a posse do candidato eleito, nesta quarta-feira, 4 de novembro. De autoria do deputado federal Chico Alencar (Psol-RJ), o PL busca formar equipes de transição obrigatórias para inibir tentativas de sabotagem dos candidatos perdedores.




O debate ressurge após Flávio Bolsonaro, logo após perder as eleições no segundo turno, dizer que não reconhece a vitória de Lula e alegar que irá pedir a anulação das eleições. Dois dias depois de sua derrota, Flávio fugiu para os Estados Unidos e publicou uma carta que, inicialmente, se coloca como o “verdadeiro presidente eleito do Brasil”. Em seguida, ele alterou o texto e se denominou como “líder do Brasil”. Outro exemplo utilizado pela proposta foi a tentativa de golpe de Estado arquitetada pelo então presidente, Jair Bolsonaro, para evitar o então recém-eleito presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva assumisse o cargo. A trama golpista, pela qual Jair Bolsonaro está preso, culminou nos atentados de 8 de janeiro de 2023, em Brasília.




No Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF), nesta quarta-feira, 4, ministros devem debater sobre a ação penal que pede a absolvição do ex-prefeito de Duque de Caxias e candidato a governador do Rio de Janeiro em 2026, Washington Reis de Oliveira (MDB-RJ), por crimes ambientais e loteamento irregular. Oliveira havia sido condenado por corrupção passiva e ativa em 2025. O relator do caso, o ministro Flávio Dino, julgou infundados os pedidos formulados, mantendo a condenação de modo integral.




Nesta semana, Lula deverá fazer um pronunciamento oficial à nação pela primeira vez após ser reeleito para o quarto mandato. A informação foi divulgada pelo canal do WhatsApp, “Exército do Lula”, porém, sem anunciar o dia e o horário. Por áudio, enviado ao grupo, o presidente afirma que precisa recuperar a voz que “está muito rouca”. Sem citar o nome do candidato derrotado Flávio Bolsonaro, ou comentar a declaração que ele não reconheceria o resultado das eleições, Lula também declarou que ele e seu “general Janones” irão “trabalhar muito”. “Nós vamos fazer com que a verdade prevaleça neste país e a mentira desapareça de uma vez por todas”, completou.




Estão na agenda da semana de 02 a 06 de novembro:




DIREITOS HUMANOS







Câmara







Auxílio Financeiro (CPD, 03/11, 13h):

 Comissão debate sobre PL 2169/2022 que determina um auxílio de um salário mínimo mensal para pais ou responsáveis, que tenham renda de meio salário mínimo, de pessoa com deficiência grave ou moderada.




Aquisição de imóvel rural a indígenas (CPOVOS, 03/11, 14h):

 Comissão debate sobre incluir os povos indígenas, as pessoas das comunidades dos quilombos, e os demais povos e comunidades tradicionais como beneficiários dos recursos do Fundo de Terras e da Reforma Agrária (FTRA) para a aquisição de imóvel rural.




Selo alerta de Lista Suja (CICS, 03/11, 15h):

 Comissão debate e vota no PL 922/2025, que cria o selo de alerta para empresas que constam na “Lista Suja” do trabalho análogo à escravidão.
















STF







Atentado ao pudor (RE 1093553, 04/11, 14h):

 Ministros julgam se expressão ‘ato obsceno’ no art. 233 do Código Penal é constitucional ou não, por ser uma expressão vaga.




Liberdade de Imprensa (Rcl 78354, 04/11, 14h):

 Ministros julgam se a empresa Rádio e Televisão Iguaçu S.A deve pagar indenização por danos morais por reportagem sobre a prisão preventiva de um policial militar.













POLÍTICA







Senado

 Comissão debate e vota sobre a Proposta de Fiscalização e Controle, que tem o objetivo de apurar, junto ao TCU, fraudes estruturadas no pagamento de benefícios previdenciários e na contratação de créditos consignados.
















STF







Loterias (ADPF 1212, 04/11, 14h):

 Ministros julgam se as leis municipais que autorizam os municípios a instituir e explorar loterias nos seus territórios ofendem a competência privativa da União, a livre concorrência e o princípio federativo.

title: Meral Beştaş: The process is facing a serious deadlock
content:
Peoples' Equality and Democracy Party (DEM Party) MP Meral Danış Beştaş spoke to ANF about the current stage of the Peace and Democratic Society Process aimed at resolving the Kurdish question, the decision to make implementation of the framework law conditional on a National Security Council decision, and the government's approach to the process.




Meral Beştaş pointed out that Kurdish demands for democratic rights and freedoms had been pushed into the background of political discussions. She said that a lasting solution required moving beyond a security-oriented approach, implementing legal reforms and taking concrete steps towards democratisation.




‘Political will must be translated into concrete steps’




Beştaş stated that although the framework law had passed through Parliament, the anticipated MGK decision required for its implementation had still not been issued. She pointed to the government's lack of political will in the process and said:




"I believe the fundamental issue here is the failure to translate political will into concrete and binding legal steps. Political will has been expressed during the process, and there have been important developments, including the framework law and, before that, the parliamentary commission. However, there has been a serious delay in establishing a legal basis for these developments, and the process is being prolonged. We can see this, and it is currently the most widely discussed issue among the public in Turkey.




On the one hand, the framework law is not being implemented because the National Security Council decision is still awaited. On the other hand, the failure to implement the parliamentary commission's report is creating uncertainty about how transitions will take place and when the law will be enforced.




We have always maintained that peace is achieved through reciprocal steps and mutual responsibility among institutions. The government must not postpone its own responsibilities. The state has the means to enact legislation, establish legal guarantees and remove obstacles to democratic politics. These responsibilities have legal, administrative and political dimensions. Yet we are witnessing an avoidance of these obligations.




There should actually be a simple measure: Which steps have been taken? Which have not? Which obligations remain unfulfilled? We need to examine the situation from this perspective, and these questions must be discussed transparently in public. Frankly, the government's constant introduction of vague conditions does not advance a solution. On the contrary, it prolongs the process even further. We must never lose sight of this.




When the 27 February call was made, neither the government nor the state had taken any steps. Nevertheless, Mr. Öcalan made that call unilaterally and fulfilled its requirements. As you may recall, there was considerable debate at the time. For weeks, experts argued that the call would not be followed and that Mr. Öcalan would not fulfil its requirements. But none of those predictions came true, and the steps were taken. This is a matter of building trust and demonstrating sincerity. Our demand, proposal and expectation are clear: rather than waiting for assessments by the security bureaucracy, political authorities must take concrete steps towards a democratic solution. We are being very specific about this. There is a saying: 'Actions speak louder than words.'




Political authorities make statements in different ways almost every day. Of course, that is not a bad thing. It is positive that these statements reach society. But everywhere we go, people ask very clear and concrete questions: Why are no steps being taken? Why are our prisoners still behind bars? Why are sick prisoners still waiting to die in prison? Why can people still not return to their country? Why have the doors still not been opened? Why has the Peace and Political Participation Coordination Board still not been established? So far, no satisfactory or convincing answers have been given to any of these questions."




‘A new decision-making mechanism has been established above Parliament’s authority’




Meral Beştaş stated that making the implementation of the law dependent on the assessment and confirmation of security institutions undermined parliamentary authority and democratic oversight. She recalled that the DEM Party had previously objected to leaving the process to the discretion of the security bureaucracy.




Beştaş said: "The law is before the Grand National Assembly of Turkey. Ultimately, the legislative body represents the highest expression of the people's will. We are all represented there, as are all political parties. However, the process is being left to the discretion of the security bureaucracy. In a sense, Parliament is being stripped of its authority, creating a form of tutelage. We openly objected to this and, from the very first day, expressed our criticisms and pointed out the many shortcomings of the framework law. At the same time, we said that we supported it in order to open the door and make participation possible. But we will never accept its misuse. It is being used negatively and interpreted in ways that undermine its purpose.




The National Security Council decision has now created a situation in which a new decision-making mechanism has been established above Parliament's authority. We are saying that a commission must be established immediately, not only within the National Security Council but also within the Grand National Assembly of Turkey. Monitoring bodies consisting of representatives of civil democratic organisations, activists, women and young people should also oversee and monitor the process. 




However, by insisting that this responsibility belongs exclusively to the National Security Council, they are placing the security perspective above everything else. Article 6 of the Constitution is very clear: sovereignty belongs to the nation. Article 7 establishes that legislative authority belongs to Parliament. Of course, the National Security Council is also a constitutional institution. Its role requires a separate and broader discussion. However, this institution cannot be given the authority to make binding decisions that subject the implementation of a law passed by Parliament to particular security assessments.




We maintain that the implementation of the law must be subject to oversight based on objective criteria, governed by legal rules, and that decision-making processes must be transparent. A structure must be established to ensure mutual responsibility and accountability throughout the monitoring process. We believe this mechanism should oversee the process. 




Unfortunately, the proposed commission has still not been established. The Speaker of Parliament makes statements to the press on this issue almost every day, on various occasions. Yet visits to political parties have still not taken place. Uncertainty continues to be prolonged over the structure of the proposed body, the extent of representation within it and the responsibilities of other political parties.




This further increases criticism of the democratic process, undermines trust and raises questions about sincerity. These are legitimate concerns and justified criticisms."




‘The process is a matter of democratisation and law’




Meral Beştaş pointed out that the process was not limited to disarmament and the cessation of conflict. She emphasised the need to take steps concerning political prisoners, the right to hope, the appointment of trustees and the expansion of democratic political space.




Beştaş drew attention to the deadlock in the process and said: "I would like to emphasise that, at the stage we have reached, there is a serious deadlock and the process is being put on hold and deliberately prolonged. This process is not merely about laying down arms and ensuring an end to conflict. It is also a process of resolving political and legal problems through democratic means and building a democratic society.




The priorities include enacting democratic legislation, implementing existing laws, issuing decisions that secure people's freedom, releasing prisoners, implementing the rulings of the European Court of Human Rights (ECtHR) and ending the practice of appointing trustees. We could extend this list even further. Are we now waiting for a National Security Council decision to implement ECtHR rulings? Are we waiting for a National Security Council decision to release prisoners?




The parliamentary commission's report is extremely important. It was adopted unanimously. The report contains various recommendations, while legislative proposals and packages are also on the agenda. MPs from the governing party have also signed the report. It addresses women's rights, equality and many other issues. Yet the authorities are acting as though none of these matters had ever been discussed, acknowledged or read. There is an attitude of ignoring and obscuring these issues. We have repeatedly stated that this approach must change. Unfortunately, no steps have yet been taken in this regard.




There is also a political dimension to the issue. The legal and political dimensions must be distinguished from one another. The fact that Abdullah Öcalan, the principal interlocutor and political actor in the process, is still being held on Imrali, that his meetings are being obstructed and that the outcomes of these meetings are not being reflected across all aspects of the process constitutes a serious problem. The political consequences of this situation are very clear.




We have been discussing the legal dimension for years, so I do not want to repeat the same points. However, there are also political questions awaiting answers. Which journalists and academics will be involved in the process? Has the Peace and Conflict Coordination Board begun its work? We expect steps to be taken on these issues and the obstacles preventing Mr. Öcalan from playing his role to be removed. Yet there has still been no explanation.




The process is being presented as normal, and messages of determination are being issued. We are told that the process is important and that it concerns Turkey's most significant unresolved issue. However, these statements never go beyond broad expressions that everyone can interpret as they wish. Frankly, no one can disregard the connection between the Kurdish question and the question of democracy. This is a matter of democratisation, democratic integration and law. All these dimensions must be addressed together. Kurds want to live in this country as equal and free citizens, just like everyone else. The political, legal and administrative obstacles preventing this must be removed.




There is no basis for assuming that these issues concern only Kurdish society or the Kurdish movement, or that they are limited to expanding the space for democratic politics. It is impossible to achieve a lasting and positive solution without recognising the underlying causes of the problem."




‘The Kurdish question is not a security issue, but a matter of democratic rights’




Meral Beştaş stated that treating the Kurdish question solely as a security issue had led to demands for democratic rights, including the status of Kurds and education in their mother tongue, being excluded from discussions. She emphasised that these demands must be negotiated and guaranteed to achieve lasting peace.




Beştaş said: "First of all, this is not a security issue. Viewing the Kurdish people's struggle for existence solely as a security issue means ignoring the historical and political reality of the question. This is a matter of identity, equal citizenship, mother tongue, representation and democratic rights. Removing weapons from the equation is, of course, extremely important, but it does not in itself constitute a democratic solution. We need to be clear about this.




These demands are not new. As I mentioned earlier, education in the mother tongue, the free use of the mother tongue in public life, strengthening participation in democratic life, democratising electoral processes and ensuring equal citizenship are demands that have been voiced and fought for over many years. Lasting peace cannot be built by excluding them.




The question of political status is also an important part of this discussion. Establishing a democratic system in which Kurds can organise freely with their own identity, express their political will and have a say in local government is one of the essential demands. What needs to be done is to address these demands as matters of democratisation and law rather than treating them solely within a security framework.




There is no insurmountable barrier between security concerns and democratic rights and demands. On the contrary, guaranteeing democratic rights is one of the fundamental conditions for lasting peace. The path to a dignified peace lies not in postponing these demands, but in negotiating them and providing guarantees for them. Our fundamental approach is clear: politics must replace weapons, law must replace conflict, and equality must replace denial.




As you also pointed out in your question, the continuation of the security-oriented approach and the continued use of the language of the period of conflict mean that the process is perceived not as a new beginning, but as a continuation of the war. If we fail to define the problem correctly and develop our language accordingly, we will move further away from a solution.




There is an issue we have repeatedly raised in our speeches: we must build the language of peace. To achieve this, Kurds, the democratic public and society as a whole must remain determined and continue their struggle. Rather than approaching the issue through the concepts of terror and terrorism, we must develop a language that accurately defines the question and is based on democracy and peace. There is no alternative to struggling to change this language and build peace.




The greatest source of support in this regard is the peoples of Turkey. The peoples, particularly the Kurdish people, must express their demands, struggles, positions and objections loudly and clearly. They must organise around these demands and struggle together with the broadest possible sections of society."

title: "Jülide Kural Yalnız Değildir”: Kadınlar imzaya çağırdı
content:
Sanatçı Kadir İnanır’ın yaşamını yitirmesinin ardından Jülide Kural’a yönelik cinsiyetçi saldırılar ve hakaretlere karşı “Jülide Kural Yalnız Değildir” başlıklı dayanışma kampanyası başlatıldı. Kampanyayı başlatan kadınlar, Kural’la dayanışma göstermek için herkesi imza vermeye çağırdı.







Kampanyaya imza ile destek vermek için

 burayı 

tıklayabilirsiniz.







Kampanya metninde, Jülide Kural’ın özel yaşamının kamuoyu önünde sorgulanmasına ve itibarsızlaştırılmaya çalışılmasına tepki gösterildi.




Bir kadının saygınlığının medeni durumuna bağlı olmadığının vurgulandığı metinde, Kural’ın yalnızca Kadir İnanır’ın hayat arkadaşı olmadığı, kendi emeği, birikimi ve sanatçı kimliğiyle toplumsal yaşamda yer edindiği belirtildi.




Kural’ın hayat arkadaşını kaybettiği ve yas tuttuğu bir dönemde saldırılara maruz bırakılmasına dikkat çekilen açıklamada, yasın kişisel bir süreç olduğu ve kimsenin bir başkasının nerede, nasıl ve ne kadar süreyle yas tutacağına karar veremeyeceği ifade edildi.




İnsanların kişilik haklarını ve mahremiyetini hiçe sayan, dedikoduları ve doğruluğu bilinmeyen iddiaları toplumsal linçe dönüştüren anlayışın kınandığı metinde, Kadir İnanır’ın anısına ve Jülide Kural’ın yasına saygı gösterilmesi istendi.




Kampanya metninin sonunda imzacı kadınlar, Jülide Kural’la dayanışma içinde olduklarını belirterek herkesi kişilik haklarına, özel yaşamın mahremiyetine ve Kural’ın yasına saygı göstermeye çağırdı.



















25 KASIM'A GİDERKEN




Jülide Kural: Tanık Olduğum Şiddet Korkusuzluğu Öğretti  




19 Kasım 2019










İmzaya çağrı metninin tamamı şöyle:




" Jülide Kural Yalnız Değildir!




Sanatçı Kadir İnanır'ın yaşamını yitirmesinin ardından, sanatçı Jülide Kural'a yönelik sürdürülen cinsiyetçi saldırıları ve hakaretleri kabul etmiyoruz.




Bir kadının özel yaşamının kamuoyu önünde sorgulanmasını ve kendisinin itibarsızlaştırılmaya çalışılmasını reddediyoruz.




Hiçbir kadının saygınlığı medeni durumuna bağlı değildir. Jülide Kural, yalnızca Kadir İnanır'ın hayat arkadaşı değil; kendi emeği, birikimi ve sanatçı kimliğiyle toplumsal yaşamda yer edinmiş bir kadındır.




Üstelik bütün bunlar, hayat arkadaşını kaybetmiş bir kadının yas tuttuğu günlerde yaşanıyor. Yas, herkesin kendi hissettiği biçiminde ve kendi iç zamanında yaşadığı insani bir süreçtir. Bir insanın nerede, nasıl ve ne kadar süreyle yas tutacağına başkaları karar veremez. Yas tuttuğu günlerde bir kadını kendisini savunmak zorunda bırakmak kabul edilemez bir hoyratlıktır.




İnsanların kişilik haklarını ve mahremiyetini kamuoyu önünde hiçe sayan, dedikoduları ve doğruluğu bilinmeyen iddiaları dolaşıma sokarak bunları toplumsal linçe dönüştüren anlayışı kınıyoruz.




Yaşamını yitiren bir sanatçının anısına ve hayat arkadaşının yasına gösterilmesi gereken saygının, özel yaşamları üzerinden yürütülen tartışmalarla gölgelenmesini kabul etmiyoruz.




Biz aşağıda imzası bulunan kadınlar, Jülide Kural'la dayanışma içinde olduğumuzu ifade ediyor; herkesi kişilik haklarına, özel yaşamın mahremiyetine, Kadir İnanır'ın anısına ve Jülide Kural'ın yasına saygı göstermeye davet ediyoruz."



















“BEN ROSA LUXEMBURG” 




Sahnede iki devrimci kadın: Jülide mi? Rosa mı? 




10 Aralık 2022













Ne olmuştu?




Oyuncu Kadir İnanır’ın 26 Haziran 2026’da yaşamını yitirmesinin ardından sanatçı Jülide Kural’a İnanır’ın yeğeni Levent İnanır miras hakkı üzerinden sözlü saldırdı.




Kural’ın özel yaşamı, İnanır’la birlikteliği ve yas süreci de kamuoyunun gündemine taşındı.




Kadir İnanır’ın 2022 yılında noter huzurunda hazırlattığı vasiyetnamesinde mal varlığını uzun yıllardır birlikte olduğu Jülide Kural’a bıraktığı ortaya çıktı. Vasiyetin açıklanmasının ardından İnanır’ın yeğeni Levent İnanır, dayısının sağlık sorunları nedeniyle vasiyetnameyi hazırladığı sırada irade sorunu yaşadığını öne sürerek hukuki yollara başvuracaklarını söyledi.




Jülide Kural, T24’ten Sibel Yükler’e yaptığı açıklamada hem miras iddialarına hem de kendisine yönelik söylemlere yanıt verdi. İnanır’ın büyük bir servete sahip olduğu iddiasının doğru olmadığını belirten Kural, mal varlığının birlikte yaşadıkları ev, üç eski otomobil ve bankadaki bir miktar birikimden ibaret olduğunu söyledi.




Kural, İnanır’la evlenmemelerinin kendi tercihi olduğunu belirterek birlikteliklerinin hukuki bir statüden değil, sevgi, güven ve ortak yaşam iradesinden beslendiğini söyledi. Kendisinin bağımsız bir kadın olarak emeği ve kişiliğiyle var olduğunu vurgulayan Kural, gerçek dışı iddialar ve kişilik haklarına yönelik saldırılar karşısında hukuki süreç başlatacağını duyurdu.




Yas tutma biçimi de tartışma konusu yapıldı




Levent İnanır’ın, Jülide Kural’ın Kadir İnanır’ın ölümünden bir hafta sonra Bodrum’a tatile gittiği yönündeki açıklamaları da tartışmalara neden oldu. Kural ise bu iddiayı reddederek İnanır’ın mezarıyla ilgilenmek için üç hafta İstanbul’da kaldığını, ardından Bodrum’a tatil için değil, yaşadığı sağlık sorunları nedeniyle psikolojik destek almak amacıyla gittiğini açıkladı.




Kural, kendisi hakkında yapılan rencide edici açıklamalar ve hakaretler nedeniyle hukuki süreç başlatacağını da söyledi.




Müjde Ar’dan Jülide Kural’a destek




Tartışmalara sanatçı Müjde Ar da tepki gösterdi. T24’ten gazeteci Sibel Yükler’e konuşan Ar, Kadir İnanır ile Jülide Kural’ın 20 yılı aşkın birlikteliklerine tanıklık ettiğini belirterek Kural’a yönelik saldırılara karşı çıktı.




Ar, “Jülide Kural korkunç bir şekilde kadına şiddet sarmalının içine düşürüldü. Kadınlar olarak onun daha fazla incinmesine müsaade etmeyeceğiz” dedi. Ar, kamuoyunu Kural’ın maruz kaldığı saldırıların meşrulaştırılmasına izin vermemeye çağırdı.







(EMK)

author: FMF Staff
title: Deporting Afghans to the Taliban by Way of Pakistan Is a Betrayal That Gets the United States Nothing
content:
The Trump administration is reportedly preparing to put more than 150 Afghans on a flight to Pakistan, where they would then be transferred across the border into Taliban-ruled Afghanistan. AfghanEvac, a coalition advocating for Afghan allies, says some of those facing removal are the brothers and sons of men who served alongside U.S. forces. The first flight could leave as early as Monday, just one day before Election Day in the United States.

Because the United States cannot deport people directly to Afghanistan, it lacks official diplomatic relations with the Taliban regime; the plan routes them through Pakistan. Call it what it is: a deportation to the Taliban with a layover. Officials reportedly told The New York Times that the removal is, in effect, to Afghanistan, and detainees have been told the same. Pakistan’s role is to carry out the handoff.

What the layover adds is risk. Afghans would be moved through a third country and beyond any oversight, and placed in the hands of authorities who have no obligation to protect them. From there, they could be pushed across the border to a regime they fled and one that would seek to harm them. These are the people who escaped Taliban rule after August 15, 2021.

Pakistan is not safe for Afghans. Since 2023, the Pakistani government has expelled over 2.4 million Afghan refugees back to Afghanistan as relations with the Taliban have deteriorated. Earlier this year, Pakistani officials ordered law enforcement agencies nationwide to arrest Afghans without valid visas. This is part of a years-long campaign of forced returns that has sent millions of Afghans back to a country where many face homelessness and unemployment. Many of those Afghan refugees were born and raised in Pakistan.

The Taliban’s “amnesty” is empty words. It is not a guarantee of safety.

On its first day back in power in August 2021, the Taliban announced a general amnesty for Afghans who worked with Western-backed forces and the former republic government of Afghanistan. That promise was never kept. The United Nations has documented reports of extrajudicial killings, arbitrary detentions, and other abuses. The families of former U.S. partners have particular reason to fear for their safety.

The policy to return Afghans to Afghanistan also lends credibility to the Taliban.

When the United States sends people into Taliban-controlled Afghanistan, even through a middleman, it implies that returning is safe. It suggests that the United States is willing to rely on the assurances of a regime that has repeatedly broken its promises and violated fundamental rights. Deporting Afghans in this way serves the Taliban’s desire to be treated as a legitimate government and to establish normal relations with the Trump administration.

The Trump administration advanced a similar narrative last year in May, when it ended temporary protections for Afghans, claiming that “Afghanistan has had an improved security situation” despite clear evidence to the contrary.

Cooperating, even indirectly, with a regime that has barred half the population of Afghanistan – girls and women – from education and public life, and has violated every international and national law gains the United States nothing in return. It is neither smart nor logical. It would not serve the U.S. now or in the future. It adds to the humiliation of how the U.S. withdrew from Afghanistan and handed the country back to the Taliban, a terrorist group it fought for 20 years.

The United States gains nothing from this policy. It loses far more.

The cost of this policy lands on American credibility. The United States asked Afghans to translate, guard, drive, gather intelligence, cook, clean, implement the many projects, and fight beside its forces, and promised to stand by them. Abandoning those allies, or their families, breaks that promise and abandons its obligation to protect people who are in harm’s way because they supported the U.S. mission.

The damage goes beyond Afghanistan. Future partners in any other conflict will remember how the United States treated those who stood with it. This is not border security. These individuals have already undergone vetting. It does not make Americans safer. It uses federal resources to send people toward danger, and abandons those who trusted the United States.

63% of Americans do not want Afghans to be deported.

A bipartisan national poll by AfghanEvac and HIAS, designed and run by Lake Research Partners and The Tarrance Group, found that 84 percent of likely 2026 voters say America should keep its promise to Afghan wartime allies. By more than two to one, voters oppose deporting hundreds of Afghan refugees who assisted U.S. forces to third countries where they have no connection, and 63 percent oppose deporting Afghan allies to such countries. Seventy-six percent support restoring protection programs for Afghans whose resettlement cases were already approved. Support for admitting Afghan allies rises from 52 percent to 72 percent once voters learn who these partners are.

Call your Member of Congress and your two senators. The Capitol switchboard is (202) 224-3121. Ask the operator to connect you with your Member’s office. Ask them to:

Publicly oppose this deportation flight and press the administration to halt removals of Afghans from the U.S.

Ask them to sign the discharge petition for the bipartisan Afghanistan TPS Act, which would protect Afghans already in the U.S.

Keep the promises made to Afghans who stood with us.

A simple script: I’m a constituent. I’m calling to ask [Member’s name] to oppose deporting Afghans to the Taliban through Pakistan and to protect Afghans who are already in the United States. Keeping our word to our allies is not only the right thing to do, it’s also a smart thing to do. We must deliver on our promise.

The United States made a promise. For 20 years, Afghan allies delivered, risking their lives and putting their families in danger in support of the U.S. mission in Afghanistan. The American people continue to stand with the Afghans who are already in the U.S. They believe it’s the right thing to honor its commitments. Deporting Afghans is not a sound policy, does not advance U.S. interests, and will only undermine America’s credibility.

For more on Afghan deportation, follow AfghanEvac here and here.

Source: AfghanEvac; the New York Times; Amu TV; USCIS.

author: Kodao Productions
title: ‘Make autonomy genuine,’ group urges BARMM Government
content:
A consortium that observed the recent elections for the creation of the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) urged its newly created parliament to make their hard-won self-government genuine.




Katungod Bangsamoro, a non-partisan and Commission on Elections-accredited observer last September 14 polls, also said the BARMM Parliament must address the historical injustices committed against the Bangsamoro, resist elite capture, and uphold their right to self-determination.




The group made the appeal as the BARMM Parliament convened for the first time on Friday, an event it described as “an important milestone in the long struggle of the Bangsamoro people for self-determination, justice, and genuine autonomy.”




“It opens a new chapter in the peace process and offers an opportunity to turn decades of struggle, sacrifices, and negotiations into meaningful democratic governance,” Katungod Bangsamoro co-convenor Atty. Carlos Isagani Zarate said.




Can it? Will it?




In its first ever session on Friday, the BARMM Parliament elected its former interim chief minister Abdulraof Macacua of the Bangsamoro Federalist Party to the post while Atty. Amer Zaakaria Rakim was elected Speaker.




In his address to the 80-strong Bangsamoro Congress, President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. said the creation of the parliament is a milestone in the peace process between the Manila government and the Moro Islamic Liberation Front, “marking the transition from armed struggle to peaceful democratic governance.”




Winning the right to govern was a significant achievement, Marcos said, adding: “Never forget the struggle that people have endured. Serve with humility. Carry the hopes of many generations and honor their sacrifices through good governance.”




Katungod Bangsamoro, however, cautioned last month’s elections do not guarantee lasting peace or genuine self-government. “The real measure of this new Parliament is whether it can confront the historical injustices and deep-rooted grievances that fueled decades of armed rebellion and demands for secession in the Bangsamoro,” the group said.




The consortium recalled the failures of previous autonomous government projects, such as the six-year Bangsamoro Transition Authority (BTA), that did not resolve “fundamental problems” of the Bangsamoro, such as land dispossession, discrimination, political exclusion, economic marginalization, and militarization.




The group blamed both the national government and local political and economic elites who perpetuated the injustices.




Political elites in the mix




Katungod Kangsamoro said the newly elected Parliament must resist elite capture and political dynasties.




“The first parliamentary elections have already exposed serious concerns over clan domination, money politics, electoral violence, allegations of manipulation, and factional rivalries. These should serve as a warning that changing the form of government does not automatically change the way politics is practiced,” it said.




While majority of the brand-new parliament were veterans of the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF), nearly a fifth of the chamber are made up of local political dynasties and elites.




The BARMM Grand Coalition Party, led by Abdulrahman Mangudadatu, captured 15 seats, representing established political clans from Maguindanao and surrounding provinces. Other prominent political families – such as the Adiongs, Hatamas, Masturas, and Midtimbangs – continue to maintain local power bases.




More than three-fourths of the parliament were MILF members who are however split into factions. Macacua-led Bangsamoro Federalist Party has 31 seats. United Bangsamoro Justice Party, led by Al-Haj Murad, has 30 seats.




Macacua wrested the chief minister post of the BTA Parliament from Murad in March 2025, leading to tentions between the two MILF factions in the last elections.




 

Women account for 13 seats while sectoral and indigenous representation has eight seats.




“Autonomy must never be reduced to the sharing of political positions, the accommodation of powerful families, or the distribution of economic opportunities among favored interests. Neither should the Bangsamoro region be used as a convenient arena for national political maneuverings or as a source of economic and political advantage for competing elites,” Katungod Bangsamoro said. # 

(Raymund B. Villanueva)




The post 

‘Make autonomy genuine,’ group urges BARMM Government

 appeared first on 

Kodao Productions

.

The Feds have a broad understanding of the different facets of the resistance and they have used these investigations as a means to map out the specific organizations, influential organizers, and networks of solidarity and collaborative activity.
