title: Αίμων Τουφεξής, φυλακές Δράμας: Μια πρώτη τοποθέτηση για την υπόθεση της 1/7 στη Θεσσαλονίκη
content:
Μια πρώτη τοποθέτηση για την υπόθεση της 01/07 στη Θεσσαλονίκη




Αφού μίλησαν πολιτικοί, μίντια, μπάτσοι, ανακριτές, εισαγγελείς και κάθε λογής φερέφωνα της εξουσίας, ήρθε η ώρα να τοποθετηθώ και εγώ.




Γράφω από τη φυλακή της Δράμας για την υπόθεση και για την προφυλάκισή μου. Όπως είναι ήδη γνωστό στις 10/07 η αντιτρομοκρατική υπηρεσία πραγματοποιεί εφόδους σε σπίτια στη Θεσσαλονίκη και στα Χανιά εξιχνιάζοντας υποτίθεται τον εμπρησμό στο σπίτι της πολιτεύτριας της ΝΔ Αφροδίτης Νέστορα όπου υπό άγνωστες μέχρι στιγμής συνθήκες, βρήκε τραγικό θάνατο η μητέρας της. Την ίδια μέρα συλλαμβάνονται ένας αναρχικός, μια αναρχική και ένα ακόμα άτομο και τους αποδίδεται ένα βαρύτατο κατηγορητήριο που περιλαμβάνει μεταξύ άλλων, συγκρότηση και ένταξη σε τρομοκρατική οργάνωση, ανθρωποκτονία με ενδεχόμενο δόλο – τετελεσμένη και σε απόπειρα, έκρηξη, προμήθεια και κατοχή εκρηκτικών. Τα ΜΜΕ ως όργανα της κρατικής προπαγάνδας και σε μια ακόμα προσπάθεια αναζωπύρωσης ενός κλίματος τρομοϋστερίας εξαπέλυσαν επίθεση προς το αναρχικό κίνημα της πόλης, συνδέοντας συλλογικότητες και καταλήψεις εντελώς αυθαίρετα με την υπόθεση ενώ διέρρευσαν στοιχεία της δικογραφίας διαπομπεύοντας τους κατηγορούμενους σε συνεργασία με την αστυνομία.




Η δική μου δίωξη ξεκινάει 5 μέρες μετά μιας και ο 3ος κατηγορούμενος ψευδώς καταθέτει στην ανακρίτρια ότι τα κλειδιά του διαμερίσματός του (το οποίο κατά τα λεγόμενα της αντιτρομοκρατικής χρησιμοποιήθηκε ως ορμητήριο και καταφύγιο από το δήθεν επιχειρησιακό ζευγάρι) τα είχε παραδώσει σε μένα στις 26/06 με την πρόφαση ότι θέλω να φιλοξενήσω κάποιους φίλους μου διανθίζοντας την κατάθεσή του και με ένα σωρό άλλα ψεύδη για να την κάνει πιο πειστική.




Ο καθένας θα μπορούσε εύλογα να αναρωτηθεί για ποιο λόγο ο τρίτος κατηγορούμενος να πει ψέμματα και για το πρόσωπό μου συγκεκριμένα. Όχι όμως σε μια υπόθεση που εμπλέκεται η αντιτρομοκρατική και στην οποία κατηγορούνται αναρχικοί. Είναι γνωστό πως τα προηγούμενα χρόνια η αντιτρομοκρατική έστησε κατηγορητήρια και έστειλε ανθρώπους στη φυλακή για να αθωωθούν αυτοί αργότερα στα δικαστήρια, είναι γνωστό πως εξαφάνισε ή πως ξαφνικά εμφάνισε “στοιχεία” τα οποία ουδεμία σχέση με την πραγματικότητα είχαν, είναι γνωστή η εμμονή της με τον αναρχικό επαναστατικό χώρο, είναι δεδομένο πως ακολουθεί πολιτικές σκοπιμότητες και χτίζει πολιτικές καριέρες. Στην περίπτωση αυτή θεωρώ δεδομένο ότι η αντιτρομοκρατική με τις γνωστές μαφιόζικες μεθόδους της και τις ψυχολογικές και όχι μόνο πιέσεις που άσκησε, έπεισε τον 3ο κατηγορούμενο πως κατονομάζοντας έναν άλλο άνθρωπο, ως κάτοχο των κλειδιών, θα έχει μια καλύτερη ποινική μεταχείριση.




Έτσι στις 16/07 το πρωί που βγήκα από το σπίτι μου μαζί με τη σύντροφό μου, με περικύκλωσαν γύρω στους δέκα ενόπλους της αντιτρομοκρατικής συλλαμβάνοντας με και επιπλέον προσάγοντας τη σύντροφό μου. Έπειτα από πέντε ώρες δεμένος πισθάγκωνα και με φορεμένη κουκούλα μου ανακοινώνουν ότι θα μου πάρουν αποτυπώματα με τη βία, καθώς και το κατηγορητήριο, που είναι κοινό με τους υπόλοιπους. Την επόμενη, οδηγούμαι στην εισαγγελέα όπου μου απαγγέλλεται και επίσημα το διογκωμένο κατηγορητήριο και λαμβάνω προθεσμία για απολογία. Στις 20/07 με μοναδικό στοιχείο την ψευδή κατάθεση του 3ου κατηγορούμενου, ανακρίτρια και εισαγγελέας αποφασίζουν την προφυλάκισή μου. Από νωρίς αντιλήφθηκα πως επρόκειτο για προειλημμένη απόφαση κατά παραγγελία της αντιτρομοκρατικής, καθώς δεν δόθηκε καν το περιθώριο να εξεταστούν οι μάρτυρες υπεράσπισης ενώ σύμφωνα με το άρθρο 211 του Κώδικα Ποινικής Δικονομίας, αν γινόταν η δίκη με την ψευδομαρτυρία ως μοναδικό ενοχοποιητικό στοιχείο, οι ίδιοι οι δικαστές θα ήταν υποχρεωμένοι να προχωρήσουν σε αθωωτική απόφαση. Έκανα προσφυγή κατά της προφυλάκισης, απορρίφθηκε χωρίς καμία απάντηση στα επιχειρήματά μου παραθέτοντας μάλιστα κομμάτια άσχετης υπόθεσης για διακίνηση μεταναστών. Η αίτηση για άσκηση αναίρεσης από τον εισαγγελέα του Αρείου πάγου Φλωρίδη (αδερφός του υπουργού) απορρίφθηκε χωρίς αιτιολογία με σημείωση μιας γραμμής επί του δικογράφου. Η αυθαιρεσία τους όμως δεν τελείωσε εκεί. Στο τελευταίο δεκαήμερο του Σεπτέμβρη καλούν και τους τέσσερις κατηγορούμενους εκ νέου για την αναβάθμιση του κατηγορητηρίου εντάσσοντας όλες τις κατηγορίες κάτω από τον 187Α παρ.1. Σύμφωνα με τις διαβεβαιώσεις της ανακρίτριας δεν επρόκειτο για νέα στοιχεία αλλά για ένα τεχνικό νομικό ζήτημα. Ασφαλώς όταν παρουσιάζομαι στις 30/09 εμφανίζονται ως δια μαγείας καινούρια 3.5ΤΒ βιντεοληπτικού υλικού σε ψηφιακή μορφή που είναι αδύνατη η αντιγραφή της στη μορφή που παρουσιάστηκαν, μέχρι και τέσσερις μέρες μετά. Πως γίνεται όμως η συνήγορος του 3ου κατηγορούμενου να κάνει δηλώσεις στα κανάλια περί αυτού του υλικού διαστρεβλώνοντας το περιεχόμενό του αμέσως μετά την απολογία μου το μεσημέρι στις 30/09;;; Τι πληροφόρηση είχε;;; Μήπως και αυτό το σόου συμβαίνει για να δημιουργηθούν εντυπώσεις και βεβαιώσεις ενοχής;;; Παράλληλα με το μιντιακό παιχνίδι τους, με μεταγάγουν σε χρόνους που τα επιτρεπόμενα επισκεπτήρια στις φυλακές καθιστούν αδύνατη την επαφή με το δικηγόρο μου τόσο στην πρώτη κλήση 30/09 όσο και μετά την προθεσμία, στις 09/10 ενώ έφτασαν στα αφτιά μου καταγγελίες ότι ο τρίτος κατηγορούμενος πιέζεται από την αντιτρομοκρατική να εμπλέξει και άλλα ονόματα στην υπόθεση κάτι που μέχρι εκείνη την στιγμή δεν είχε κάνει. Με όλα αυτά τα δεδομένα και αφού οι μεθοδεύσεις της ανακριτικής αρχής, των μίντια και της αντιτρομοκρατικής είναι προφανείς απέναντί μου αποφάσισα σαν μια πρώτη κίνηση να αιτηθώ η απολογία μου να γίνει εφόσον λάβω γνώση της νέας απολογίας του βασικού κατήγορού μου δηλαδή του τρίτου κατηγορούμενου η οποία είχε προγραμματιστεί για μια εβδομάδα μετά τη δική μου. Η ανακρίτρια αρνήθηκε το αίτημά μου αρχικά, τόσο προφορικά όσο και το να το δεχθεί γραπτώς, ενώ τελικά το αποδέχτηκε όταν της απεστάλη σχετικό μέηλ από το συνήγορό μου, δείχνοντας πως βρίσκονται σε μια διαδικασία διαμόρφωσης του κατηγορητηρίου ανάλογα με την υπερασπιστική μου γραμμή με μόνο σκοπό την εμπλοκή μου στην υπόθεση και την καταδίκη μου σε δεύτερο χρόνο.




Δεν είχα αυταπάτες πως η αστική δικαιοσύνη έχει το ρόλο του αμερόληπτου εγγυητή των δικαιωμάτων ή της ισότητας μπροστά στο νόμο. Πρόκειται για μηχανισμό αναπαραγωγής των ταξικών σχέσεων εξουσίας και προστασίας της πολιτικής και οικονομικής ελίτ. Η δικαιοσύνη είναι τυφλή λένε, αλλά φαίνεται πως ο αμφιβληστροειδής της λειτουργεί άψογα ανάλογα με το ποιόν έχει απέναντί της. Ενώ βρίσκομαι προφυλακισμένος χωρίς στοιχεία, ενώ οι φτωχοδιάβολοι αυτού του κόσμου γεμίζουν τις ελληνικές φυλακές για μικροπαραβάσεις, ενώ σε αγωνιστές/στριες αποδίδονται εξοντωτικές ποινές, το πολιτικό σύστημα και τα αφεντικά του, όντας υπεύθυνα για την καταλήστευση του δημόσιου χρήματος που οδήγησε τη χώρα στα μνημόνια και το λαό στην εξαθλίωση, έχοντας λεηλατήσει και συνεχίζοντας να καταστρέφουν το φυσικό πλούτο της, έχοντας αφήσει τις δημόσιες υποδομές να ρημάζουν με τραγικές συνέπειες στα Τέμπη, τρώνε με χρυσά κουτάλια.




Η διαδρομή και η στοχοποίησή μου




Στα 7 χρόνια της πολιτικής μου παρουσίας στην πόλη της Θεσσαλονίκης έχω συμμετάσχει σε πληθώρα κοινωνικών ταξικών αγώνων πάντα με πρόσημο την απελευθερωτική επαναστατική προοπτική. Έχω βρεθεί σε απεργιακές συγκεντρώσεις, αντιφασιστικές εκδηλώσεις, κινητοποιήσεις αλληλεγγύης σε μετανάστες/στριες, έχω υπερασπιστεί τις καταλήψεις και τα κοινωνικά κέντρα, έχω στηρίξει αγώνες κατά της έμφυλης βίας, έχω συμμετάσχει σε συναυλίες οικονομικής ενίσχυσης σε πολιτικούς κρατούμενους και σε συγκεντρώσεις συμπαράστασης διωκόμενων στα δικαστήρια. Κίνητρο να αγωνιστώ μου έδωσε η αδικία και η ταξική καταπίεση που υπάρχει παντού γύρω μας. Κίνητρο μου έδωσαν οι ειδήσεις για τους εργαζομένους που δεν γύρισαν από το μεροκάματό τους, ο φόβος της απόλυσης και της συνεπακόλουθης ανέχειας, οι ρατσιστικές πολιτικές αλλά και το μίσος μεταξύ των καταπιεσμένων που το κράτος συστηματικά καλλιεργεί, τα κυρίαρχα πρότυπα του ατομικισμού και της ανέλιξης “επί πτωμάτων”, η (αναμενόμενη για τους αναρχικούς) καχυποψία σε κάθε λογής σωτήρες του λαού και διαχειριστές της κρατικής εξουσίας. Ανάγκη μου ήταν και είναι να εκθέσω την υποκρισία της κυρίαρχης τάξης (που μας παρασέρνει όλο και βαθύτερα στο χορό του θανάτου και της καταστροφής και) τα εγκλήματα της οποίας όταν δεν βαφτίζονται εθνική ασφάλεια ή εξοστρακισμοί τόσο βολικά ονομάζονται ‘‘η κακιά στιγμή’’ για να κρυφτεί ο δομικός και διαχρονικός χαρακτήρας τους. Βέβαια για τις περιπτώσεις που στο όνομα της ιμπεριαλιστικής επέκτασης ισωπεδώνουν ολόκληρες πόλεις για το μοίρασμα του κόσμου, δημιούργησαν ένα συγκεκριμένο όρο: “παράπλευρες απώλειες”.




Γιατί η κυριαρχία, στην εποχή του ώριμου θεάματος, διαστρεβλώνει νοήματα συνεχώς. Στη γλώσσα τους ελευθερία γίνεται η ελευθερία της κατανάλωσης και της εκλογής του καταπιεστή, ως δικαιοσύνη νοείται η επιβολή του ισχυρού στον ανίσχυρο και κυρίως η τιμωρία όποιου/ας παρεκκλίνει, αλληλεγγύη είναι η υποταγή στα αφεντικά για το καλό της εθνικής οικονομίας, αξία είναι η εργασία που υπάγεται στο κεφάλαιο, ζωή είναι η συσσώρευση και η κατανάλωση αγαθών πριν το θάνατο ή ακόμα πιο ψυχρά η ασφαλιστική αποτίμηση του ρίσκου του θανάτου. Και όμως στο δικό μας λεξιλόγιο η ελευθερία βιώνεται ως η κίνηση για έναν κόσμο χωρίς κράτος και εξουσιαστές, δικαιοσύνη ως η έλλειψη του αισθήματος της αδικίας που η πραγματικότητα που ζούμε μας δημιουργεί, αλληλεγγύη η βάση της ισότητας και του αγώνα που κάνουμε, αξία η διεκδίκηση της ζωής που το υπάρχον μας αρνείται.




Όραμά μας λοιπόν είναι πάντα η οικοδόμηση ενός κόσμου στον οποίο η ανθρώπινη ζωή, την όποια το κράτος και το κεφάλαιο τόσο εύκολα θυσιάζουν στο βωμό του κέρδους, θα θεωρείται κεντρικός άξονας και σκοπός. Η πάλη για την ανατροπή του παλιού κόσμου σημαίνει υπεράσπιση των ζωών των καταπιεσμένων στο σήμερα καθώς και των επόμενων γενεών. Στις κοινότητές μας, μικρογραφία αυτού που θέλουμε, η αλληλεγγύη, ο σεβασμός, η μη επιβολή του ισχυρότερου στον αδύναμο από κενό γράμμα προσπαθούν να γίνουν βιωμένη πραγματικότητα. Η συμπαράσταση στους αποκλεισμένους αυτού του κόσμου αποτελούν το μόνο καθήκον που αναγνωρίζουμε.




Η παραπάνω δραστηριοποίηση, επέφερε και την αντίστοιχη στοχοποίηση από τους κρατικούς μηχανισμούς. Αυτά τα χρόνια δεν έλειψαν οι προληπτικές προσαγωγές, οι απροκάλυπτες παρακολουθήσεις της κρατικής ασφάλειας όπως συνέβη και συνεχίζει να συμβαίνει και σε πολλούς ακόμα συντρόφους/ισσες. Βέβαια η στοχοποίηση όσων αντιδρούν στην αδικία και το θάνατο που σπέρνει το κράτος δεν είναι απλώς μια συνέπεια που αφορά εμένα προσωπικά, αλλά το αποτέλεσμα ενός μηχανισμού που αντιμετωπίζει εχθρικά οποιονδήποτε αγωνίζεται για έναν καλύτερο κόσμο, οποιαδήποτε παρεκκλίνει από τα κανονιστικά πρότυπα που η εξουσία επιβάλλει. Πέραν της στοχοποίησης αυτής, και σε αυτήν την υπόθεση δεν έλειψε η ποινικοποίηση των φιλικών και συντροφικών σχέσεων μου με τους δύο πρώτους συλληφθέντες, έτσι ώστε το παραμύθι της αντιτρομοκρατικής να μοιάζει περισσότερο πειστικό. Δεν συνιστά πρωτοφανή τακτική, την έχουμε ξαναδεί στο παρελθόν σε υποθέσεις όπως της Ηριάννας και του Περικλή, του Β. Σταθόπουλου, του Τ. Θεοφίλου, του Π. Καλαϊτζή κα. Όταν η εξουσία βασίζει διώξεις σε συντροφικές σχέσεις τότε αυτές παύουν να αφορούν το οποιοδήποτε γεγονός και στρέφονται προς την ίδια τη στάση ζωής ή και την αλληλεγγύη. Οι αυθαίρετες προφυλακίσεις και τα κατηγορητήρια έχουν ως στόχο πρωτίστως την ηθική εξόντωση των διωκόμενων ατόμων και την περαιτέρω τρομοκράτηση των αγωνιζόμενων υποκειμένων. Όλοι αυτοί οι εκ των προτέρων “ένοχοι” βρέθηκαν έγκλειστοι, στερούμενοι όχι μόνο την ελευθερία τους, αλλά και τη ζεστασιά της ανθρώπινης εγγύτητας. Το ψυχολογικό και κοινωνικό κόστος του εγκλεισμού είναι τεράστιο. Παρά το γεγονός ότι στην πλειοψηφία αυτών των υποθέσεων τελικά υπήρξαν αθωωτικές αποφάσεις και τα στημένα κατηγορητήρια πέσανε πανηγυρικά, κανένα δικαστήριο και κανένας άλλος κρατικός θεσμός δεν έδωσε πίσω το χαμένο χρόνο ούτε επανόρθωσε για την καταστροφή στις ζωές τους.




Καθώς διαφαίνεται πως για ακόμα μια φορά η αστική δικαιοσύνη ήταν αποφασισμένη να αποδώσει ευθύνες σε όποιον βρέθηκε στα χέρια της σύμφωνα με προεκλογικές επιταγές, έχει σημασία να αναλογιστούμε το γενικότερο πλαίσιο στο οποίο διαδραματίζεται και το εν λόγω έργο. Οι διακρατικές συγκρούσεις και οι ιμπεριαλιστικές επεμβάσεις που τείνουν να εξελιχθούν στον γενικευμένο Γ’Παγκόσμιο Πόλεμο έχουν το χαρακτήρα αναδιάταξης των σχέσεων ισχύος μεταξύ των κρατών αλλά και του ξεπεράσματος των εσωτερικών αντιφάσεων του συστήματος. Το ελληνικό κράτος συμμετέχοντας ενεργά στα πολεμικά μέτωπα που έχουν διαμορφωθεί προετοιμάζει την κοινωνία σε όλα τα επίπεδα. Υπέρογκοι στρατιωτικοί εξοπλισμοί, δηλώσεις για φέρετρα σκεπασμένα με σημαίες, τόνωση του εθνικού φρονήματος σε σχολεία, ερευνητικά προγράμματα για το στρατό στο πανεπιστήμιο, εξουδετέρωση κάθε φωνής αντίστασης στο εσωτερικό (άνοδος εθνικισμού, όξυνση της καταστολής), αύξηση διάρκειας στρατιωτικής θητείας. Όλα αυτά ώστε οι από τα κάτω να βρεθούμε και να πεθάνουμε στην πρώτη γραμμή για τα συμφέροντα του κεφαλαίου.




Στον γενικευμένο όλεθρο που ταχύτατα μας οδηγούν κράτος και κεφάλαιο, είναι ιστορική αναγκαιότητα η δημιουργία ενός ταξικού αντιπολεμικού κινήματος, η υπεράσπιση των αναρχικών ιδεών και πρακτικών. Οφείλουμε στους αγώνες του παρελθόντος να υπερασπιστούμε τη μνήμη των κινημάτων απέναντι στη λήθη που επιβάλει η εξουσία, τη μνήμη αυτή που τιμά τους χιλιάδες νεκρούς της τάξης μας και μεταμορφώνεται σε ανυπακοή. Μέσα από τη φυλακή δηλώνω πως θα συνεχίσω να βαδίζω σε αυτό το πανέμορφο και συνάμα δύσβατο μονοπάτι του αγώνα με πίστη στην Υπόθεση. Οι ιδέες μας δεν φυλακίζονται και δεν σκύβουν το κεφάλι μπροστά στις αλυσίδες τους. Όσο υπάρχουν άνθρωποι που θυμούνται, που τολμούν, που επαναστατούν, υπάρχει ελπίδα για ανατροπή του παρηκμασμένου συστήματος.




Εφόσον έφτασαν μέχρι το σημείο να χρησιμοποιήσουν μια ψευδομαρτυρία για να με κλείσουν στη φυλακή δεν μπορώ παρά να μην τους εμπιστεύομαι στο τι άλλο ψέμα ή φτιαχτό στοιχείο θα σκαρφιστούν για να με κρατήσουν εκεί. Για αυτό και δηλώνω προς πάσα κατεύθυνση πως αρνούμαι όλες τις κατηγορίες που μου αποδίδονται. Στοχοποιήθηκα και διώκομαι λόγω των πολιτικών και φιλικών μου σχέσεων με τον Χάρη και τη Γεωργία, αλλά και λόγω της πολιτικής μου παρουσίας.




ΜΗ ΚΑΡΤΕΡΑΤΕ ΝΑ ΛΥΓΙΣΟΥΜΕ ΜΗΤΕ ΓΙΑ ΜΙΑ ΣΤΙΓΜΗ.




Ο ΑΓΩΝΑΣ ΓΙΑ ΤΗΝ ΤΑΞΙΚΗ ΚΑΙ ΚΟΙΝΩΝΙΚΗ ΑΠΕΛΕΥΘΕΡΩΣΗ ΣΥΝΕΧΙΖΕΤΑΙ.




ΕΧΟΥΜΕ ΔΙΚΙΟ – ΘΑ ΝΙΚΗΣΟΥΜΕ

Δηλώνω προς πάσα κατεύθυνση πως αρνούμαι όλες τις κατηγορίες που μου αποδίδονται. Στοχοποιήθηκα και διώκομαι λόγω των πολιτικών και φιλικών μου σχέσεων με τον Χάρη και τη Γεωργία, αλλά και λόγω της πολιτικής μου παρουσίας.

author: CNT Madrid
title: Los teatros de Madrid vulneran el derecho a la huelga
content:
La convocatoria de Huelga General para el 11 de noviembre ya se está haciendo notar en determinados espacios escénicos de la Comunidad de Madrid. Algunos espectáculos programados para ese día están siendo cancelados o desplazados a otras fecha diferentes. Esto, según denuncian los sindicatos CNT y CGT, implica una vulneración del derecho a secundar la Huelga General a numerosas personas trabajadoras de estos espacios escénicos madrileños.




Estas situaciones se están produciendo por ejemplo en Stage Entertainment, la empresa que programa el musical El Rey León en el teatro Lope de Vega y El Alma Al Aire en el Coliseum. En ambos casos, la empresa desplazó ambas funciones del miércoles 11 al lunes 9, poniendo el día 11 como el día de libranza del personal, tal como se informó mediante comunicación interna hecha a las jefaturas de los departamentos técnicos. Lo mismo ha sucedido en el músical Six, en el teatro Gran Vía, gestionado por el grupo Smedia, y en otros teatros de este mismo grupo, como el Alcázar (Un Dios salvaje) o el Fígaro (Victoria).




Un caso similar se ha dado en los teatros Luchana, donde se ha cancelado toda la programación, dando también el día libre al personal y vulnerando así su derecho a secundar la huelga.




Se han producido también irregularidades en el musical Los Miserables, representado en el teatro Nuevo Apolo, donde ATG Entertainment ha actualizado su calendario para mover la función del día 11 al domingo 8. La plantilla de ATG fue informada del cambio mediante comunicación interna. Otros espectáculos de esta misma productora han sido cancelados ese día, como es el caso de los musicales Querido Evan Hansen en el teatro Rialto, Wicked en el Nuevo Teatro Alcalá y La función que sale mal en el Amaya.




Además se han aplazado los conciertos programados para el 11 de noviembre en el Auditorio Nacional de Música, dependiente del Ministerio de Cultura, siendo reprogramados otros días de esa misma semana.




Para los sindicatos mencionados estos son hechos muy graves que el público asistente a esos espectáculos debe conocer. Por esa razón, tanto CNT como CGT avanzan la realización de piquetes informativos en diferentes teatros madrileños. Ambas centrales anarcosindicales también hacen un llamamiento al público madrileño que hubiera adquirido entradas para el día de Huelga General, el 11 de noviembre: rechazad el cambio de fecha y solicitad la devolución de los importes abonados.

author: Maverick Avila
title: ‘Long fight ahead after ethanol spill in Tañon Strait’ – lawyer in landmark case
content:
Wastewater from an ethanol spill discolors Bais Bay, the Philippines’ Negros Oriental province, on Oct. 28, 2025, days after ethanol wastewater spilled into the bay, causing significant damage to coastal and marine ecosystems. Image courtesy of MarGale Bancairen.

Despite the somewhat funny concept, they were serious about their goal: Stop the oil exploration in the Tañon Strait by Japan Petroleum Exploration (JAPEX).

In 2007, Philippine environmental lawyer Rose Liza Eisma-Osorio and four other law professors in Cebu City sat around laughing at an idea: representing marine mammals in court.

Despite the somewhat funny concept, they were serious about their goal: Stop the oil exploration in the Tañon Strait by Japan Petroleum Exploration (JAPEX). The protected seascape between the islands of Cebu and Negros is home to 14 whale and dolphin species, as well as coral reefs and mangrove forests. The Japanese energy company performed seismic surveys and drilled an exploration well, which drove away dolphins and whales from the strait.

It was an ambitious plan, as animals had never been named as petitioners. Eisma-Osorio and fellow lawyer Golly Estenzo Ramos filed the first petition representing the resident marine mammals in December 2007. Their colleagues filed a second petition on behalf of fishing communities directly affected by the exploration activities.

The case, Resident Marine Mammals of the Protected Seascape Tañon Strait v. Secretary Angelo Reyes, went on for several years. In April 2015, the Philippine Supreme Court ruled to void the contract that allowed the exploration, development, and exploitation of petroleum resources within the Tañon Strait.

Eisma-Osorio joined Oceana Philippines as a consultant in 2015, a year after the NGO was established. At 56, she now leads the campaign and legal department as senior director of Oceana Philippines.

On October 24, 2025, a major ethanol wastewater spill hit Bais Bay, part of the Tañon Strait Protected Seascape (TSPS). Oceana Philippines collaborated with marine scientists to assess the severity of the spill. Their research, with the latest report in July this year, found that Universal Robina Corporation’s (URC) ethanol plant continued to leak wastewater, killing fish, corals and seagrass. The NGO is also consulting with fishing communities to build a court case against the company.

With more than 25 years of experience in natural resources law and policy, Eisma-Osorio believes it’s her personal responsibility to ensure there is legal accountability. In an interview with Mongabay via video call, she talked about representing marine mammals, the reaction from the community, and her current legal fight.

Mongabay: What was your thought process in deciding to represent the marine mammals in such a landmark case?

Rose Liza Eisma-Osorio: It was an ambitious undertaking. We wanted to challenge the thinking that only humans can file cases in court. And we knew there were two ways it could go: the court would throw out the case or decide to hear it. So we wanted to be sure, and we had Attorney Ramos and myself to act as stewards representing the marine mammals.

If you look at the case caption, the marine mammals were joined and represented by us, meaning they were also signing as individuals while being represented by us, because if the court did not allow them to join as litigants, it could still allow us to represent the dolphins and whales.

Mongabay: How was the case received back then, by communities, environmental groups, and even the court?

Eisma-Osorio: Around that time, what was refreshing about the campaign was that there was already an organic movement, especially the Save Tañon Strait Movement. There were very active Cebuanos, individuals, and students who helped raise awareness. The fisherfolk we represented were part of it too, so there was community engagement, because we knew they were the injured party in a way.

That was also the strategy behind two petitions. In the Philippines, you have to suffer an injury for the court to say you’re entitled to the remedy. We wanted the fisherfolk to prove their reduced catch and be heard, in the event that the court did not listen to the resident marine mammals case, since proof of injury was still a big question mark at that time.

Mongabay: At what point did you say, ‘This case is winnable?’ What was the turning point in lobbying to represent the resident marine mammals, especially with court updates?

Eisma-Osorio: We didn’t expect it to be in our favor. When we filed it in December 2007, the turning point was that even before the court decided, JAPEX pulled out. That was our early victory.

Then in 2015, the court decided in our favor, which was an added bonus. What the court zeroed in on, and what made it a landmark case, is that you don’t have to show proof of personal injury to represent nature as stewards and give nature legal standing in court. Only that you are here representing nature and this is the damage that was done.

We were surprised, and we said, “OK, we’ve set a precedent in Philippine jurisprudence.” This makes it easier for our citizens to file environmental cases now.

Mongabay: What immediate effect did you see after the Supreme Court decision?

Eisma-Osorio: After we won the case, I became Oceana’s consultant, and we decided to work on the management plan for Tañon Strait, because even if it was established as a protected seascape in 1998, there was no management plan at all.

Our contribution went beyond the case, [we got] into managing the area well and enforcing the laws and rules there. We left a living document that allows the agencies and local governments to work together to manage Tañon Strait in a better way.

Mongabay: Nine months after the October 2025 ethanol spill in Bais Bay, Silliman University marine scientists found the pollution killed up to 69 percent of coral cover in the assessed reef areas. What does it mean for Oceana to lobby again for the community?

Eisma-Osorio: Tañon Strait will always be our legacy campaign. When there are challenges like the ethanol spill, we need to go back and do our part.

We worked with the scientists from Silliman University to elevate the issue into a national concern, and we were pleasantly surprised by how our [press release] became viral. The communications tool is always useful, and it helped move the Department of Environment and Natural Resources. They have filed a criminal action against the responsible officers of URC, and I think the case is now ongoing.

But there’s still the matter of the ongoing leakage that continues to affect the fishing communities. And if it’s not stopped, then it might become worse and turn the bay into a wasteland.

We’re not entirely satisfied, because there are legal tools like the Writ of Kalikasan that could ensure the bay is restored and responsible actors are held accountable.

It’s early days, but there is an opportunity to ensure the community gets the justice it deserves for the damage to their resources and livelihood. Bais Bay is small compared to the entire stretch of Tañon Strait, but it’s ground zero for some because it’s where you do the dolphin and whale watching. If livelihoods are thriving there, you’ve protected Tañon Strait. That’s why it’s my personal quest to ensure environmental justice for what happened in Bais Bay.

Mongabay: Do you think it’s going to be a long battle ahead?

Eisma-Osorio: Yes, it will be a long battle ahead. We will be battling this together with the community. Nothing about them should be without them.

title: The Dark Side of the “Machine God”: 5 Unsettling Truths About Big Tech’s AI Obsession
content:
Silicon Valley routinely promises a sparkling utopia where artificial intelligence will cure complex diseases, optimize global labor, and render the very concept of money obsolete. Yet behind the polished keynotes and corporate public relations, a far more unsettling reality is taking shape. A small handful of ultra-wealthy tech oligarchs, the heads of Meta, Google, OpenAI, Anthropic, and xAI, are making unilateral decisions about the collective future of humanity, operating entirely outside democratic oversight or public accountability.

Silicon Valley routinely promises a sparkling utopia where artificial intelligence will cure complex diseases, optimize global labor, and render the very concept of money obsolete. Yet behind the polished keynotes and corporate public relations, a far more unsettling reality is taking shape. A small handful of ultra-wealthy tech oligarchs, the heads of Meta, Google, OpenAI, Anthropic, and xAI, are making unilateral decisions about the collective future of humanity, operating entirely outside democratic oversight or public accountability.

This concentration of power exposes a jarring central paradox: the exact same tech CEOs who claim AI will solve humanity’s greatest challenges simultaneously warn that the technology could trigger civilizational extinction, openly describing their pursuit as “summoning the demon.” Rather than pausing development, these executives have accelerated an apocalyptic arms race to build ultra-powerful systems, framing themselves as indispensable guardians of human survival.

To understand where artificial intelligence is truly taking society, we must look past corporate marketing and examine the underlying worldviews, historical lineages, and material harms driving the tech elite. Moving beyond superficial consumer hype reveals how a toxic mix of fringe ideologies, extractive labor practices, and authoritarian state alliances is steering Silicon Valley toward what critical theorists and legal scholars call “techno-fascism.”

To make sense of Silicon Valley’s relentless drive toward Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) and Artificial Superintelligence (ASI), one must understand the bizarre ideological framework shaping its leaders. Coined by philosopher Emile Torres and computer scientist Timnit Gebru, the acronym TESCREAL encapsulates a bundle of tightly interwoven worldviews: Transhumanism, Extropianism, Singularitarianism, Cosmism, Rationalism, Effective Altruism, and Longtermism.

Dr. Emile Torres highlights a critical historical truth at the heart of this ideology: transhumanism is fundamentally “eugenics on steroids.” Unlike nineteenth-century eugenics, which sought merely to optimize the existing human species through selective breeding, transhumanism seeks to use radical technology to completely replace and transcend humanity, engineering an entirely new posthuman species. Within Silicon Valley AI circles, this hypothetical superintelligence is explicitly referred to as a “Machine God.” Tech CEOs effectively act as high priests, competing to bring an all-knowing digital deity into physical existence.

This radical ideology shapes corporate roadmaps in concrete, disturbing ways:

Sam Altman (OpenAI): In a blog post titled “The Merge,” Altman argued that AI surpassing human intellect is inevitable, framing un-merged human beings as a temporary “biological bootloader” for digital intelligence that will ultimately fade into an evolutionary side-branch. Altman notably paid $10,000 to join a brain-uploading waitlist with Nectome and co-founded a brain-computer interface venture to facilitate digital integration.

Ray Kurzweil & Demis Hassabis (DeepMind): Representing Extropianism and Singularitarianism, Kurzweil champions the doctrine of living long enough to achieve digital immortality, targeting a self-improving “singularity” by 2032. Hassabis, DeepMind’s co-founder, operates under a similar singularitarian impulse to engineer self-evolving intellect.

Eliezer Yudkowsky (Rationalism): A foundational figure in modern rationalist thought who famously posited a utilitarian moral calculation arguing that forcing a single person to endure 50 years of relentless torture is ethically preferable to an unfathomable number of people experiencing the mild inconvenience of a speck of dust in their eye.

Elon Musk (xAI/SpaceX): Demonstrating classic Longtermism, Musk explicitly cites the expansion of the Sun billions of years in the future to justify prioritizing multi-planetary space colonization over addressing immediate, real-world human suffering on Earth today.

”All of these ideologies emerged out of modern transhumanism… an ideology according to which we should develop advanced technologies so that we can radically re-engineer the human organism and ultimately create a new posthuman species… In and around Silicon Valley, extremely advanced AI, so-called superintelligence, is even called the ‘Machine God.’ Which means these Big Tech CEOs, racing to release ever more powerful AI, are effectively casting themselves as priests who bring the Machine God’s power to the world.” — Dr. Emile Torres, Philosopher and Historian

Ultimately, the TESCREAL moral math reduces living human beings to disposable statistical noise. By prioritizing hypothetical trillions of digital beings living in far-future galactic utopias, Silicon Valley executives grant themselves ethical permission to ignore present-day environmental destruction, global labor exploitation, and systemic social destabilization.

While modern machine learning is marketed as objective, hyper-advanced science, its core mathematical architecture is directly inherited from 19th-century eugenics. The foundational statistical tools of modern AI, logistic regression, statistical correlation, and neural network pattern classification, were designed by early British statisticians Francis Galton and Karl Pearson. Both were explicit eugenicists who invented these mathematical formulas specifically to measure, rank, and classify human populations to prove that white, wealthy elites were genetically superior.

This mathematical heritage is deeply intertwined with the institutional birth of Silicon Valley itself:

The Palo Alto System: Railroad tycoon Leland Stanford established a horse-breeding facility in Palo Alto, devising rigorous sprint training for foals to optimize racehorse traits, a logic of biological optimization that established the region’s cultural template.

Academic Sterilization: Stanford University’s first president, taxonomist David Starr Jordan (author of Why Fish Don’t Exist), applied Stanford’s horse-breeding logic to human populations, aggressively advocating for state-enforced sterilization of individuals deemed socially or biologically “inferior.”

The IQ Test: Stanford psychologist Lewis Terman reworked a French educational diagnostic tool to create the Stanford-Binet IQ test, explicitly designed to rank human value early in life and justify preventing low-scoring populations from reproducing.

Transistor Pioneers & Eugenics: William Shockley, whose Nobel Prize-winning transistor research birthed Silicon Valley’s hardware industry, spent his later life asserting that Black people were genetically inferior in intelligence. California ultimately carried out approximately 20,000 forced sterilizations — nearly a third of the U.S. total.

Modern artificial intelligence does not “think” or possess conscious understanding; it aggregates massive datasets to find statistical correlations, classify inputs, and rank outputs. Because machine learning inherits historical human data, it inherently formalizes and amplifies legacy societal prejudices under the cover of mathematical neutrality.

”The story of eugenics has always been one that says: yes, you people who have decided that you’re better than everyone else, well, you’re right. And we can find that in science, and therefore it is somehow just… The basic idea of neural networks is very much about classifying and ranking… The very idea that you can create a technology with superior intelligence already carries the assumption that not only is the machine more intelligent, but that certain people are more intelligent and certain others less so.” — Dr. Dan McQuillan and Professor Dave Karpf

When automated recruitment systems, credit-scoring engines, or predictive welfare screening tools deploy machine learning to sort human beings, they operate as high-tech engines of eugenic sorting. As Meta’s former Vice President of Civil Rights Roy Austin noted, when Amazon deployed an automated hiring algorithm trained on historical employee profiles, the system systematically filtered out female applicants. Because the training data reflected a historically white, male benchmark, the algorithm calculated that women were inherently less qualified — a classic demonstration of automated discrimination (“garbage in, garbage out”).

Silicon Valley presents generative AI as a clean, weightless, digital miracle. In reality, as Microsoft Research scholar Kate Crawford notes in Atlas of AI, tech conglomerates rely on a deeply extractive industry model that operates like historic colonialism, framing public data, human artistic creation, and natural resources as unowned entities waiting to be extracted for corporate profit.

This extraction operates across three distinct supply chains:

Mass Intellectual Property Theft: AI corporations harvest copyrighted literature, artistic portfolios, and private online tracking data across the web without consent or compensation. Anthropic, founded by Dario Amodei (a primary architect of AI “scaling laws”), paid out $1.5 billion in legal damages after illegally pirating copyrighted books to train its models. Anthropic’s data acquisition drive even involved purchasing 166 tons of physical Korean-language books to feed its algorithms, drawing fierce condemnation from Booker Prize-winning author Arundhati Roy and international creators.

Exploited Global Task Labor: The hidden engine of machine learning is not autonomous code, but massive manual human labor. Companies like Scale AI, founded by Alexandr Wang, who became a billionaire at 24 before Meta poured roughly $14 billion into his firm, rely on armies of low-wage workers in the Philippines, Kenya, and Venezuela. Paid pennies per task to label data and filter out horrific, traumatic content (“gluing eyes on dolls”), these workers suffer rampant wage theft and severe psychological trauma without basic labor protections.

Ecological Drain and Local Inequality: Training massive foundation models requires intensive mineral extraction for specialized hardware and drains immense amounts of electricity and local water to cool data centers, driving up utility bills for surrounding communities. Meanwhile, the staggering wealth concentrated at the top of Silicon Valley contrasts sharply with local service workers, many of whom are forced to live in cars, parking lots, or overcrowded apartments while working multiple jobs.

Generative AI is not an immaculate cloud of pure intelligence; it is an extractive machine that bleeds the planet’s ecosystems and human labor force dry to satisfy corporate scaling laws.

Big Tech has largely abandoned its historical posturing as a neutral, liberal political force. Instead, major tech corporations are actively forging a strategic alliance with far-right political movements, military apparatuses, and domestic surveillance agencies, a structural convergence known as Techno-Fascism.

Techno-fascism represents the explicit alliance between monopoly digital capital (led by figures like Peter Thiel, Alex Karp, Elon Musk, and Sam Altman) and nationalist state power. Rather than relying solely on traditional physical coercion, this regime enforces political control through automated mass surveillance, data integration, predictive profiling, and algorithmic discipline.

Defense contractor Palantir, co-founded by Peter Thiel and led by CEO Alex Karp, exemplifies this trajectory. In April 2026, Palantir released a chilling 22-point manifesto summarizing Karp’s book The Technological Republic. Analyzed by researcher Rezgar Akrawi, the document explicitly outlines the theoretical foundation of digital fascism:

Point 1: Asserts that the Silicon Valley engineering elite has a “moral duty” to serve the state’s war machine, converting individual conscience into corporate military capital.

Point 5: Deploys deterministic logic to eliminate moral debate, declaring that “the question is not whether AI weapons will be built; the question is who will build them.”

Point 6: Demands the reinstatement of mandatory military conscription, institutionalizing state coercion in service of geopolitical conflict.

Point 21: Promotes explicit civilizational racism, asserting that “some cultures have produced vital advances while others remain dysfunctional and regressive”, a high-tech revival of the colonial “white man’s burden” used to justify domination.

Palantir translates this ideology into real-world surveillance and military infrastructure:

Mass Deportation Systems: Palantir secured a $29.8 million contract with U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) to power its Immigration Lifecycle Operating System (ImmigrationOS) and Investigative Case Management system. Palantir also developed the ELITE app, which aggregates financial records, social media activity, home addresses, and emergency room Medicaid data into profile maps to calculate probability scores for tracking and deporting immigrants.

Battlefield Targeting Platforms: Palantir, alongside Google, Amazon, and Microsoft, maintains extensive targeting and battlefield management contracts with military apparatuses, supplying real-time AI decision-making platforms deployed in war zones like Gaza.

State Surveillance Integration: Palantir, SpaceX, and Anduril are frontrunners building military projects like the “Golden Dome,” while collaborating with Musk’s Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE) to create APIs linking Homeland Security systems with IRS tax data to target undocumented residents.

”Palantir is creating digital infrastructure for the multiple forms of state violence and control that contemporary authoritarianism relies on, from the software facilitating mass deportations to the AI wielded in wars against colonized people… As technology scholar Jathan Sadowski writes, ‘From inception, Palantir’s purpose has been to provide… the “ontology layer” of fascism, helping to give its ideological goals a material reality.’” — Alberto Toscano, Author of Late Fascism, quoting Jathan Sadowski

This corporate-state pipeline relies on harvesting massive citizen datasets while bypassing privacy laws. In South Korea, for example, the Justice Ministry granted private tech firms access to a state database containing facial photos of 50 million citizens and 120 million foreigners to train commercial surveillance algorithms without user consent.

In his analysis of digital authoritarianism, philosopher Mark Coeckelbergh adapts Hannah Arendt’s classic concept of the “banality of evil.” Historically, Arendt observed that systemic atrocities are rarely committed by monstrous ideologues alone, but by ordinary bureaucrats blindly executing administrative rules without empathy, moral reflection, or personal judgment.

In the modern digital age, AI automates this moral detachment. By delegating life-altering decisions to opaque algorithms, human managers, state agencies, and corporate executives insulate themselves from moral accountability, treating automated recommendations as unassailable mathematical truth. This structural dynamic shifts society away from constitutional rights and toward “algorithmic governmentality” — a system where populations are quietly sorted, disciplined, and controlled through statistical correlations.

This algorithmic control manifests across everyday life:

Workplace Tyranny: Ride-hailing drivers for platforms like Uber and Lyft report having their accounts automatically deactivated without human review when facial recognition software glitches after a driver shaves a beard or gets a haircut. Fast-food employees face similar automated firings, leaving workers with no human appeal process.

Healthcare Exploitation: Hospitals deploy Palantir’s automated staffing tools to generate chaotic schedules, forcing nurses to work six consecutive days without adequate rest while automatically penalizing staff if their schedules conflict with algorithmic targets.

Predictive Profiling: Public schools and social welfare agencies feed family backgrounds, socioeconomic statuses, and behavioral histories into predictive algorithms. These tools profile children early in life, predicting future academic failure or criminal involvement and preemptively restricting their opportunities.

To deepen this control, technofascism targets human psychology. Drawing on Erich Fromm’s Escape from Freedom, Coeckelbergh notes that modern alienation and isolation create deep psychological anxiety. Where historical authoritarianism offered mass political movements to relieve this anxiety, Big Tech offers synthetic AI intimacy. Mark Zuckerberg’s push to deploy AI chatbots to “fight the loneliness epidemic” by creating artificial friends represents a strategy of hyper-personalized emotional pacification: users submit to algorithmic direction in exchange for simulated empathy.

Furthermore, these systems suffer from severe internal dysfunctions. AI systems generate sycophantic feedback loops, telling authoritarian leaders what they want to hear, while risking complexity collapse, data blackouts, and unmanageable administrative failures.

When public figures like Elon Musk openly declare that empathy is a “fundamental weakness of Western civilization,” they summarize the governing logic of technofascism: human empathy, worker rest, and democratic protections are treated as friction that must be eradicated to maximize corporate efficiency.

Despite the rapid expansion of automated surveillance and monopoly corporate power, public pushback against techno-fascism is escalating across the globe. Tech workers are organizing collective resistance under campaigns like #NoTechForIce, frontline hospital nurses are actively resisting algorithmic workplace surveillance, university students are booing AI-focused graduation speeches off the stage, and local community groups are successfully blocking data center construction to protect their water tables and power grids from soaring utility costs.

At its core, this struggle is a vital fight over human agency. The defining question of our era is whether our work schedules, civil liberties, medical care, and democratic futures will be dictated by proprietary algorithms owned by a handful of billionaires, or governed by human communities exercising democratic control.

Reclaiming human agency requires concrete structural interventions:

Enforcing Strict Liability Laws: Implementing robust regulatory frameworks, such as the EU AI Act, to hold corporate executives legally and criminally liable for algorithmic harms.

Antitrust Enforcement: Breaking up monopoly tech conglomerates that control search ecosystems, cloud infrastructure, and mobile operating platforms.

Technological Disarmament: Banning autonomous, algorithmic targeting systems in law enforcement, border control, and military applications.

Labor Unionization & Democratic Infrastructure: Supporting tech worker unions, protecting whistleblowers, and establishing publicly owned, democratically governed data infrastructure.

title: The Kurdistan Region’s experience of government – III
content:
In the previous part of our series, we examined the common causes of government formation crises that have recurred in the Kurdistan Region over the past three decades, as well as the election process of 20 October 2024. This part examines the demands put forward by the Kurdistan Democratic Party (KDP) and the Patriotic Union of Kurdistan (PUK) in negotiations, the institutional vacuum created by the failure to form a government and the price the people are paying for it.




The KDP's demands




Iraqi media reported that the negotiating delegations of the two parties reached an agreement on 4 February 2025 on a draft joint government programme comprising nine sections and 15 articles. The programme covered parliament, finance, foreign relations, relations between Erbil (Hewlêr) and Baghdad, the peshmerga, energy and the judiciary. However, negotiations over the distribution of government positions lagged behind agreement on the programme.




The KDP's offer expanded over time. In April 2025, the PUK was offered only the ministries of Peshmerga Affairs and Finance. On 6 November 2025, however, the KDP announced that it had offered the PUK the parliamentary speakership, the vice-presidency of the Kurdistan Region, the deputy premiership, eight or nine ministries and "influential positions" within the security institutions.




Three issues remained outside the scope of the offer. A KDP representative announced on 8 October 2025 that the party would not hand over the Ministry of Interior to the PUK and would not negotiate on the matter. The KDP also refused to negotiate over the Security Council, which oversees the KDP's Parastin intelligence agency and the PUK's Zanyari intelligence agency, remaining under Masrour Barzani's authority. Masrour Barzani's position as prime minister and Nechirvan Barzani's position as President of the Kurdistan Region were likewise excluded from negotiations.




The KDP insisted that cabinet positions should be distributed according to the number of parliamentary seats held by each party. Masrour Barzani said in June 2025 that his party was "making serious efforts to form a government based on the majority". The KDP began adopting a more conciliatory tone from August 2026 onwards.




The PUK's demands




The PUK demanded the ministries of Interior and Natural Resources, the chancellorship of the Security Council and a written definition of the deputy prime minister's powers in April 2025. In the following months, its demands took shape around authority over either the Ministry of Interior or the Security Council, a senior executive position and the headship of the Presidency Office of the Kurdistan Region. The KDP also rejected the PUK's demand for the headship of the Presidency Office.




PUK officials stressed that the dispute was not about the number of positions. Deputy Prime Minister Qubad Talabani said on 31 May 2026 that the problem concerned the "philosophy of partnership". The PUK declared that it continued to insist on a 50–50 division of power and genuine partnership, and that it would not join the government until it was certain that the "mistakes of the past" would not be repeated.




The PUK's second demand concerned the decentralisation of powers. Qubad Talabani cited disparities in public services between Duhok and Germiyan, calling for greater authority to be granted to governors and mayors.




The PUK's position became more flexible in the autumn of 2026. Bafel Talabani addressed the KDP in a speech on 12 October, saying: "The PUK does not want to govern without you, nor can it govern without you."




The PUK-New Generation alliance




Bafel Talabani and New Generation Movement leader Shaswar Abdulwahid signed an alliance agreement on 2 July 2026. The agreement reportedly provided for the adoption of a regional budget law, full transparency over oil revenues, independent financial oversight, the reimbursement of part of the deducted salaries and marriage loans for young people. However, the agreement contained no provision specifying which party would hold the premiership.




The alliance with New Generation gave the PUK a combined strength of 38 parliamentary seats at the negotiating table, but did not commit New Generation to joining the government. On 24 June 2026, New Generation leader Shaswar Abdulwahid said that the next prime minister should come from the alliance. However, on 19 September, he announced that no discussions had taken place regarding participation in the government.




The deadlock between the two parties




Reports in August 2025 indicated that an agreement had been reached on the general framework. According to some sources, the proposed arrangement would leave the presidency, premiership, Ministry of Interior and Ministry of Natural Resources with the KDP, while the PUK would receive deputy positions with expanded powers, the parliamentary speakership, the ministries of Finance and Peshmerga Affairs. However, neither political party officially confirmed these reports.




Four issues were subsequently reported to remain unresolved: the powers of deputy officeholders, the choice between seat-based distribution and a 50–50 division of power, recognition of the PUK-New Generation bloc, and control over the Ministry of Interior and the Security Council. Statements from the two parties also contradicted each other. The KDP announced on 16 September 2026 that an agreement had been reached, while the PUK declared four days later that no agreement existed. The Kurdistan Islamic Union (Yekgirtû), Kurdistan Islamic Group (Komele) and National Stance Movement (Helwêst), which together hold 14 parliamentary seats, announced that they would not participate in any delegation formed by the two parties.




A parliament that cannot convene




Parliament has not convened since its inaugural session on 2 December 2024. Its leadership has not been elected, parliamentary committees have not been established and not a single law has been passed. Oversight institutions have also remained ineffective. Nevertheless, MPs continue to receive salaries for duties they are not actively performing.




The Kurdistan Region has not had a budget law approved by parliament since 2013. Expenditure is determined according to monthly salary transfers from Baghdad. The terms of the Commission of Integrity, the Board of Supreme Audit and the Human Rights Commission have expired without being renewed. Without a functioning parliament to question ministers, discrepancies in public spending also remain unanswered.




Institutions and commissions with expired mandates




The Council of Ministers' four-year term expired on 10 July 2023, while the mandate of the Kurdistan Region Presidency expired in June 2023. On 24 September 2023, Iraq's Federal Supreme Court dissolved the provincial councils that had remained in office since the 2005 elections. Municipal council elections have not been held since the early 2000s. The regional electoral commission was stripped of its authority, and the most recent elections were administered by Iraq's electoral commission. The Ministry of Natural Resources has been headed by an acting minister since May 2022, while the Minister of Finance submitted a resignation letter in October 2026.




The New Generation Movement applied to Iraq's Federal Supreme Court on 9 July 2026, requesting that the ninth cabinet be recognised as a caretaker government responsible only for day-to-day affairs from 10 July 2023 onwards. The case also includes a request to suspend oil, gas and electricity contracts signed after that date. The court postponed the hearing until 26 October 2026.




Thus, among the institutions whose mandates have expired, the only elected body still formally in office is the parliament, which remains unable to convene.




De facto dual administration




The unification of 2006 brought the ministries under a single administration, but the dual structure in revenue collection, security and local government remained intact. Asayish security forces and peshmerga units continue to operate along party lines, while the Parastin and Zanyari intelligence agencies function outside formal government oversight.




Non-oil revenues from Sulaymaniyah, Halabja, Raperin and Germiyan have been monitored through a separate portal established in July 2022. Each province covers its own salary shortfall.




The division within the security sector has also persisted. On 21 September 2026, the 80th and 70th peshmerga units were reorganised into the First and Second Regional Commands under the Ministry of Peshmerga Affairs. The failure to form a government is effectively reviving the dual administrative structure that existed between 1996 and 2006, without any formal declaration of division.




The salary crisis with Baghdad




Baghdad's policy of paying salaries through federal banks has progressed differently in the two areas. In December 2024, registration in the "My Account" system stood at 96 per cent in Erbil and Duhok, compared with 35 per cent in Sulaymaniyah and Halabja. Salaries for November and December 2025 were not paid. Salaries for June 2026 were paid after a 50-day delay, with deductions totalling 120 billion dinars.




Representation in Baghdad has also become divided. Nizar Amedi of the PUK was elected President of Iraq on 11 April 2026 despite a boycott by the KDP. The KDP subsequently boycotted the federal parliament. Baghdad's approach amid this institutional vacuum is being interpreted as an attempt to deal with the Kurdistan Region through individual provinces and parties rather than through a single regional authority.




Livelihood, public services and migration




Salary increases for public sector employees have been frozen since 2016. Two months' salaries went unpaid in 2025, and each employee has accumulated between 20 million and 100 million dinars in outstanding payments. The minimum pension in the Kurdistan Region is 220,000 dinars, compared with 500,000 dinars under federal law.




Economic losses worsened with the outbreak of the war involving Iran on 28 February 2026. The price of a cylinder of cooking gas rose from 8,500 dinars to between 30,000 and 33,000 dinars, while wholesale vegetable prices doubled. The Kurdistan Regional Government spokesperson put the cost of the war up to April at 1.5 trillion dinars. Public sector recruitment has been suspended since July 2024. The appointment of 775 unemployed doctors was not completed until September 2025.




Essential public services have also faced disruption. Baghdad reportedly supplied only half of the required medicines. A teachers' boycott in early 2025 prevented 600,000 pupils at 3,000 schools from attending classes for two months. An attack on the Khor Mor gas field on 26 November 2025 reduced electricity generation by approximately 80 per cent. The field has been attacked at least nine times since 2023, and four workers were killed in an attack in April 2024.




Migration has become one of the most visible consequences of the crisis. More than 148,000 people are reported to have migrated to Europe over the past decade, while 414 people lost their lives along the way.




Pressure on women and the press




Women have paid an even heavier price for the institutional vacuum. According to official figures, 44 women were killed in 2022 and at least 30 in 2023. The Kurdistan Regional Government stopped publishing statistics in 2024. In September 2025, the Council of Ministers instructed institutions not to disclose these cases to the public. A proposal to amend the domestic violence law has been awaiting parliamentary consideration since 2015.




Pressure on the press has also increased. The Metro Center recorded 315 violations against journalists in 2025, compared with 182 in 2024. Iraq fell to 162nd place in the 2026 World Press Freedom Index published by Reporters Without Borders.




After three decades




Nine cabinets have been formed in the Kurdistan Region since 1992, but their formation has never been governed by a constitution. Governments were established through agreements signed between the two parties, and as these agreements weakened, the time required to form a cabinet increased from 46 days to more than 720 days. The causes of the crises have remained unchanged: who controls the revenues, who commands the armed forces and intelligence agencies, and how the two parties are represented in relation to each other. The current deadlock also appears to centre on the Ministry of Interior and the Security Council.




The failure to form a government in the Kurdistan Region has become not an exception but a normal feature of the system. Frozen salaries, school boycotts, medicine shortages, suppressed protests, the migration of young people and the concealment of data on the killing of women are all consequences of the same institutional vacuum. Meanwhile, the federal judiciary has become the principal authority determining the Kurdistan Region's electoral system, salary payments and oil revenues.




The steps needed in the Kurdistan Region are concrete: convening parliament and electing its leadership, adopting the budget law that has not been passed since 2013, paying withheld salaries, removing the peshmerga, Asayish and intelligence agencies from party control, putting the constitution that has been pending since 2009 to a referendum, holding provincial council elections for the first time since 2014, and resuming the publication of data on the killing of women.




The cases scheduled to be heard by Iraq's Federal Supreme Court on 26 October 2026 will mark the next stage in the process of determining the legal status of parliament and the ninth cabinet. The meeting expected between the KDP and the PUK in early November will show whether the parties can reach an agreement before then.







The Kurdistan Region’s experience of government – I

The Kurdistan Region is facing the consequences of its failure to form a government on every front, as the balance of power in the Middle East is once again being tested and the region faces the pr...

title: Eleger Lula não basta: “Se não radicalizar a gente não sobrevive”, diz editor do Revelando
content:
A disputa presidencial no Brasil chegou ao fim, no último domingo (25), com a quarta vitória de Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT). Lula venceu o segundo turno das eleições e foi reeleito com a maior votação já obtida por um candidato à Presidência, com 64.256.232 votos – 51,79% dos votos válidos contra 48,21% obtidos pelo adversário, Flávio Bolsonaro (PL).




“O que a sociedade brasileira foi capaz de fazer no último domingo foi a salvação do nosso sistema democrático”, afirma o editor-chefe do canal Revelando, Bruno Torturra, convidado do 

Pauta Pública

 desta semana.




A disputa foi marcada pela intensa mobilização nas redes socias e nas ruas contra o bolsonarismo. Além disso, também foi fundamental o papel do jornalismo e do combate à desinformação, muitas vezes por meio de novos formatos e narrativas que se adaptaram à lógica dos algoritmos para jogar luz sobre histórias que a campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro escondia.




O canal Revelando, lançado em setembro, produz reportagens e investigações jornalísticas em formato de documentário. Em conversa com Andrea Dip, Torturra fala sobre a iniciativa, analisa o cenário político pós-eleições, e destaca como a mobilização em torno da vitória de Lula representa também um desfecho biográfico significativo para o presidente e uma tomada de consciência cívica.




Para o jornalista, no entanto, a esquerda precisa ir além da resistência e articular ações de longo prazo capazes de propor avanços: “Se a gente não radicalizar a gente não sobrevive, isso aí não tem a menor dúvida.”

Veja mais episódios desta série










Como você avalia esse momento pós-eleições, depois dessa gigantesca mobilização? Tem precedentes?




Foi uma manifestação histórica. A sociedade brasileira foi capaz de fazer no domingo de eleições. Acho que tem um significado nacional gigantesco, uma salvação do nosso sistema democrático, um desfecho biográfico muito bonito para o presidente Lula. É uma mobilização, uma tomada de consciência cívica, já vi várias desse tipo na minha vida, mas nunca com esse foco, com essa clareza, vontade e gana.




E com um significado mundial também muito grande. Acho que não é à toa que a gente tá vendo gringo chorando em todo o país do mundo, uma doideira, justificadamente. A gente deu uma demonstração muito linda, mesmo, de como é que se faz para derrotar – não digo nem só a extrema direita fascista que o Flávio, de certo, representa, mas até a tecno-oligarquia, a nova utopia antidemocrática desses mesmos oligarcas, o que a digitalização da nossa vida pública representa. Então, foi uma vitória colossal.




O Trump falou hoje que ele acha que as eleições brasileiras foram manipuladas. E eu concordo com ele: elas foram, e a gente ganhou mesmo assim. A gente ganhou apesar da manipulação, não é pouca coisa o que aconteceu. E também do ponto de vista emocional – que é uma parte crucial da política que, às vezes, a gente desmerece – mas o meu coração, e acho que o coração de todo mundo que entendeu o que estava em jogo, está descarregado. Ele continua batendo forte e eu continuo emocionado, mas agora é com mais serotonina e dopamina.




Na questão da mobilização, fortificada pelo jornalismo independente, o Revelando se destacou como um dos veículos mais importantes. Sobretudo, porque a gente também viu esses boicotes dos Estados Unidos, das Big Techs e da grande imprensa. Então, queria te ouvir sobre o formato muito acertado do Revelando e qual foi o papel do jornalismo independente nesse processo?




Antes de qualquer coisa eu queria valorizar o trabalho do jornalismo tradicional brasileiro, que foi no qual nós nos embasamos para fazer o Revelando. Nós tivemos muito pouca apuração própria, no sentido de que não tivemos nenhum grande furo de reportagem nem dados inéditos. Mas o que a gente fez, e que é algo que a gente tinha uma escola muito interessante no Greg News e também no Calma Urgente, que é algo que o jornalismo tradicional tem muita dificuldade de fazer – porque eu acho que ele é um pouco preso no formalismo temático.




O jornalismo se entende como uma forma, e eu acho que isso é um problema do nosso campo, especialmente num mundo saturado de mídia. A gente tem que se apegar em uma ética e não em uma estética. Então, o que a gente fez, na verdade, é tentar pegar tudo o que a imprensa apurou e não narrar fatos avulsos, mas mostrar que isso faz parte de uma história, que tem um arco, que esses fatos montam uma cena muito mais complexa.




Eu também acho que a gente vive numa época midiática pós-jornalística, em que o jornalismo é um gênero quase periférico do tanto de mídia que é consumida. E isso é uma coisa muito perigosa: viver numa época pós-jornalística.




Então, o que a gente fez – muito intencionalmente – foi usar todos os recursos midiáticos pós-jornalísticos que tínhamos, que são muito bem-sucedidos: o uso de pessoas famosas, o uso tático de rede social, uma dinâmica que mistura um pouco de entretenimento, um pouco de humor, um pouco de emoção, um pouco de raiva, trilha, gráficos e tudo mais.




Economia de atenção, mas com o núcleo jornalístico forte, intacto. A gente não estava atrás da mera atenção dele, a gente realmente acredita na capacidade crítica de quem está nos vendo. É usar a desgraça dos algoritmos que nos sequestraram para entregar um pouco do que o algoritmo pede mas com um conteúdo que o algoritmo não encoraja. Sabíamos que ia dar meio certo, a gente apostava no projeto, sem dúvida nenhuma, mas eu te digo, a gente não imaginava que ia dar tão certo, que ia ser um impacto tão grande quanto teve.




Sobre o jornalismo independente, e a 

Pública

 é tipo um farol disso, a gente está há muitos anos na fronteira do jornalismo independente digital, acreditando que é possível ter um outro modelo de negócio e que a gente é capaz de investigar e de divulgar isso. Mas eu realmente acredito, sem exagerar, que essa eleição, eu espero, tenha sido um ponto de inflexão mesmo nessa questão. Acho que o que ficou muito claro nessas eleições é que nós estamos conseguindo atingir números de mainstream, impactos de mainstream, e a mídia industrial está se tornando uma mídia meio 

vorcarista

, que foi outro grande escândalo.




A gente achava que os interesses comerciais, organicamente eles têm um viés natural, mas a gente vai vendo que os patrocinadores hoje em dia estão editando matérias. Isso é uma quebra da separação entre comercial e editorial que o nosso campo não tem. Então, eu acho que o público precisa entender que essa independência é de interesse econômico, a gente deveria buscar comunicar isso melhor.




Acredito que o jornalismo bem feito – mesmo de veículos mais convencionais – que tomou consciência do que estava em campo e entendeu que isenção, mera isenção, era uma inércia para o abismo. Assim, o trabalho que a gente fez como classe, como categoria, foi indispensável para o Flávio perder.




Os argumentos que foram apresentados, todas as investigações pegaram um público que a consome. O fato do Flávio ser um criminoso, um representante do crime, miliciano, ter defendido o assassino de uma menina de cinco anos de graça e uma série de outras coisas, escorreu para a sociedade toda. Essa consciência foi escorrendo a boca entre as pessoas que estavam mais preocupadas, na psicose política máxima, ao trabalhador que na reta final escutou a história da Ana Clara, escutou a relação com a milícia, ficou sabendo do Willer Tomaz – e foi um trabalho que a mídia de massa se recusou a cumprir. Então, eu tô muito feliz de estar junto desse campo, de estar desse lado.




Uma tecla que vocês bateram várias vezes foi a importância de falar mais sobre o Flávio, de manter a bola no nosso campo. O Janones também enfatizou para parar de pautar a campanha em se defender de fake news – e o exército é outra coisa que vai ser estudada por muitos anos. Bom, sabemos que a extrema direita se organizou sempre muito bem nesse ecossistema digital, será que a esquerda finalmente aprendeu a jogar o jogo da internet na internet nessa campanha?




Eu tenho uma resposta um pouco polêmica em relação a isso, acho que a gente aprendeu a fazer uma guerrilha muito eficaz, um super exército, mas é em um campo inimigo. Não acho que a gente deva contar que o Janones, o Revelando e todo mundo, aprendeu a jogar o jogo das redes sociais e agora a gente vai disputar de igual para igual, porque isso não é sustentável, dentro do desenho de código e de modelo de negócio que é a infraestrutura do terreno online.




Eu temo que o nosso campo vá se deslumbrar com o sucesso e achar que a gente aprendeu a jogar o jogo da extrema direita. Porque se for olhar os exemplos dos caras que dominaram a comunicação: Carlos Bolsonaro, Lucas Pavanato, Nikolas Ferreira. Com todo respeito, esses caras não são grandes estrategistas, não são homens inteligentes, não são pessoas que estudam comunicação, eles nunca ouviram falar de nada de comunicação, não tem nem a primeira aula do curso. Eles são muito mais produtos de um ecossistema tóxico, onde gente tóxica tem vantagem e mentira e picaretagem, simplificação e ódio leva a vantagem programaticamente, dentro do programa digital mesmo.




Tudo isso para falar que a gente tem uma missão nos próximos quatro anos do governo Lula e eu espero de coração que não só a gente saiba argumentar isso com muita qualidade, mas, sobretudo, a burocracia do governo, os ministros, o PT se abra para entender o que a gente está falando e compre essa briga de verdade. Agora a gente luta com a constituição em uma mão e o código livre na outra. Não adianta segurar só uma lei analógica, sem reprogramar o código digital de onde a democracia vai operar.




O que acontece é que a gente vive em um espaço público privatizado na internet, e não só é privatizado, como antidemocrático, antirepublicano, e declaradamente atendendo os interesses dos Estados Unidos, piorado nos interesses do Donald Trump. Então, o que a gente precisa fazer aqui não é contar com o exército do Lula no WhatsApp, porque é uma questão de tempo, que isso pode não só ser desativado, mas a dinâmica de missão e ficar na tela não é sadia para a gente.




No Revelando, estamos discutindo internamente o que fazer sobre isso, porque dependeu 100% do Instagram e do YouTube para fazer o que a gente fez. De hoje em diante, queremos que o Instagram e o nosso canal de YouTube sejam a ponta de um iceberg de uma comunidade em que a gente se conhece, tem o telefone, onde a gente tem o controle democrático dos nossos seguidores, que podem conversar entre si. Então, honestamente, que bom que a gente fez o que a gente fez. Mas a gente operou em campo inadequado para o tipo de projeto que temos na mão. Para os caras ganharem a próxima ou mexerem um pouquinho melhor no algoritmo é uma questão de semanas.




Outro aspecto que tem sido comentado é a “falta de imaginação”. Como diz Paulo Demuro, a esquerda parou de imaginar um futuro, de encantar, e virou conservadora – no sentido de que temos que conservar as instituições, a democracia e, também, temos que nos defender dessas informações falsas. O que você pensa sobre isso?




A gente está conservador e tem até um termo de esquerda que eu acho muito conservador, mas que passa despercebido porque é bonito, é guerrilheiro e tudo mais: chama “resistência”. Nós somos a “resistência”.




Mas a resistência é uma posição conservadora de algum jeito, porque você não está avançando, você está segurando o que tem. E eu entendo perfeitamente, de fato. Eles estão querendo ir atrás dos direitos de todo mundo, das mulheres, dos indígenas, das florestas, mas a resistência também é uma posição insustentável no longo prazo. Ela precisa ser de curto prazo para você conseguir invadir o campo inimigo e ir para cima dele, e, para isso, você precisa de ousadia, imaginação e ambição.




Isso é uma coisa que eu acho que o PT mesmo, e a nossa esquerda viável politicamente – a esquerda que a gente é capaz de se eleger hoje no país – é muito pouco ambiciosa, muito pouco ambiciosa. Ela se conteve num lugar muito estreito de possibilidades e o mundo não permite mais isso. Não permite nem do ponto de vista ecológico. Se a gente não radicalizar, a gente não sobrevive, isso aí não tem a menor dúvida.




Mas o que me angustia – e o Mark Fisher lia muitíssimo bem – é a nossa incapacidade. A gente se remete muito ao passado, mas não imagina muito bem o futuro e eu acho que isso piorou. Até acho que nem ao passado somos mais capazes de nos remeter tanto; a gente se remete meio que ao último meme, ao último mês, ao último ano, porque em 2011, 2012, até essa data, a internet era um lugar mais aberto. O que a web era capaz de oferecer era muito distinto do que a timeline é capaz de oferecer.

title: Yeni SPK Başkanı Muhsin Atcı kimdir?
content:
Cumhurbaşkanı Erdoğan’ın imzasıyla yayımlanan karara göre, Sermaye Piyasası Kurulu (SPK) Başkanlığına Muhsin Atcı, Başkan Vekilliğine Ersin Başar Ekmekçi, kurul üyeliğine ise Yasemin Girici atandı.

Peki, SPK başkanlığına atanan Muhsin Atcı kimdir? İşte hayatı…

1979 yılında Konya'nın Ereğli ilçesinde doğan Muhsin Atcı, ilk öğreniminin ardından ortaokul ve lise eğitimini İvriz Anadolu Öğretmen Lisesinde tamamladı. Ardından İstanbul Üniversitesi Siyasal Bilgiler Fakültesi Kamu Yönetimi Bölümünden mezun olan Atcı, 2014 yılında ABD'deki Duke Üniversitesinde Kalkınma Politikası alanında yüksek lisans yaptı.

2003 yılında Vergi Denetmen Yardımcısı olarak mesleğine başlayan Atcı, 2005 yılında Stajyer Gelirler Kontrolörü, 2008 yılında Gelirler Kontrolörü ve 2010 yılında İdari ve Mali İşler Daire Başkan Yardımcılığı yaptı.

2011 yılında Vergi Denetim Kurulunun kurulmasıyla Vergi Müfettişi olarak atandı. 15 Eylül 2014 ile 7 Temmuz 2017 tarihleri arasında Ankara Büyük Ölçekli Mükellefler Grup Başkanı olarak görev yaptı.

31 Temmuz 2017'de Vergi Denetim Kurulu Başkan Yardımcılığına getirilen Atcı, bu görevini 18 Nisan 2019'a kadar sürdürdü. Daha sonra özel sektörde görev alarak Gürok Grubu bünyesinde vergi, mali işler ve risk yönetimi alanlarında çalıştı.

7 Ekim 2023'te Vergi Denetim Kurulu Başkanlığına atanan Muhsin Atcı, 1 Kasım 2026'da yayımlanan 2026/367 sayılı Cumhurbaşkanlığı Kararı ile Sermaye Piyasası Kurulu Başkanı oldu.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

title: AKOM'dan İstanbul için uyarı: Salı ve çarşamba sağanak bekleniyor
content:
İstanbul Büyükşehir Belediyesi (İBB) Afet Koordinasyon Merkezi (AKOM), İstanbul için haftalık hava tahmin raporunu yayımladı. Rapora göre İstanbul başta olmak üzere Türkiye'nin büyük bölümü, Orta Akdeniz üzerinden gelen yağışlı hava sistemlerinin etkisi altında kalmaya devam ediyor.

Önümüzdeki 7 günlük süreçte İstanbul'da çoğunlukla kapalı ve bulutlu bir havanın etkili olması bekleniyor. Hafta boyunca belirli aralıklarla sağanak yağış geçişlerinin yaşanacağı tahmin edilirken, yağışlı havanın özellikle haftanın ilk günlerinde etkisini sürdüreceği öngörülüyor.

Haftanın ilk yarısında yağmur ve sağanak yağışın etkili olması beklenirken, perşembe günü de aralıklı yağış geçişlerinin görüleceği tahmin ediliyor. Cuma günü ise havanın parçalı ve çok bulutlu olması bekleniyor.

AKOM'un haftalık hava tahmin raporu şöyle:

2 Kasım Pazartesi: Çok bulutlu, aralıklı yağmurlu

4 Kasım Çarşamba: Sağanak yağmurlu

5 Kasım Perşembe: Çok bulutlu, aralıklı yağmurlu

6 Kasım Cuma: Parçalı ve çok bulutlu

title: Liverpool maçı öncesi Fenerbahçe'ye kötü haber
content:
Fenerbahçe, Süper Lig’de sahasında Göztepe’ye 2-1 mağlup olurken, Kojo Oppong’un sakatlığının ciddi olduğu öğrenildi.

Nathan Ake'nin yokluğunda Göztepe maçında ilk 11'de sahaya çıkan Kojo Oppong, 84. dakikada yerini Yiğit Efe Demir'e bırakmıştı. Karşılaşma sonrası bu değişiklik Dirk Kuyt'a sorulmuş ve Hollandalı çalıştırıcı, "Bir ağrı hissetti ve çıkmak istediğine dair bir işaret yaptı" ifadelerini kullanmıştı.

Oppong’un Göztepe maçının ardından stadı sekerek terk ettiği görülürken, 22 yaşındaki Ganalı stoperin durumu da belli oldu. HT Spor’a göre Oppong’un sakatlığı ciddi.

Sarı-lacivertliler, Şampiyonlar Ligi’nde Liverpool’u konuk edeceği müsabakaya stoperde Milan Skriniar - Yiğit Efe Demir tandemiyle çıkabilir.

Fenerbahçe’nin Şampiyonlar Ligi’nde Liverpool’u konuk edeceği müsabaka 4 Kasım Çarşamba günü saat 20.45’te başlayacak.
